name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Join the fight to protect the unborn
body:
I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=7df2205e972a4cc8b58b087a5cbee6a2&_t=yHtRHAW8fxZfdjpbxTS04r-bYJjGipsNNiikAHKpgAmYU-wtlujyOEPYqsyh-o_nEIeAXEK4OQgB-s3VDFd_7CqpXggMqeu21ihwy6a4spw%3D)_

| | | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7df2205e972a4cc8b58b087a5cbee6a2&_e=oSqJDKCpdj2kxk8M7vSSu94knoAGVMZpnAs3zru3lN34rCdj0ShO8kqDfE1yFFV11vP7Quanh5TmQC1ZS688A8GTRiVH3R-1dtzIFUtfKq4DlUwiLrjDERNxUbGwipIPuUrmYSRC9Wgy_xXfU4JTkTOv2Dj-1UxN3slitE_y-7w3VRm_RtK377dtbDpNPyZv5hny0Zq6pTMkJEIF2Q0pXuQ2UIFT1tL1EK1bpP7yRQTe3tTo0ejfSlAXKwQdV5wsZDvj-5EnP7buYKejxHPb3Q7D_q232UdY_2-G67XDwFCB8-uEEZMzDRt6qB0tmYwWObvRpwgZnRMYhS70HXNR2Iw4y4Alili0jqTdoNA0PY5bgs0_Z0Vqd7S7E2L2oa83Y41xzp5d7HGB-4H3DCH8og%3D%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7df2205e972a4cc8b58b087a5cbee6a2&_e=oSqJDKCpdj2kxk8M7vSSu94knoAGVMZpnAs3zru3lN34rCdj0ShO8kqDfE1yFFV11vP7Quanh5TmQC1ZS688A8GTRiVH3R-1dtzIFUtfKq4DlUwiLrjDERNxUbGwipIPuUrmYSRC9Wgy_xXfU4JTkTOv2Dj-1UxN3slitE_y-7w3VRm_RtK377dtbDpNPyZv5hny0Zq6pTMkJEIF2Q0pXuQ2UIFT1tL1EK1bpP7yRQTe3tTo0ejfSlAXKwQdV5wsrQopci_G8ZuzE0XdsbR4OfjbaZAAHUQZgF80XGIR05AvrHw78L_K1DiLGugwtlqaaESfXzy32pmmDm52ICyoGKl4OU0tgEht5lkQKWAdgOYRctN9wk-EzDzXdtQOuXNTgeoRwfTCO-66WnQRWjFC7g%3D%3D) **
As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7df2205e972a4cc8b58b087a5cbee6a2&_e=oSqJDKCpdj2kxk8M7vSSu94knoAGVMZpnAs3zru3lN34rCdj0ShO8kqDfE1yFFV11vP7Quanh5TmQC1ZS688A8GTRiVH3R-1dtzIFUtfKq4DlUwiLrjDERNxUbGwipIPuUrmYSRC9Wgy_xXfU4JTkTOv2Dj-1UxN3slitE_y-7w3VRm_RtK377dtbDpNPyZv5hny0Zq6pTMkJEIF2Q0pXuQ2UIFT1tL1EK1bpP7yRQTe3tTo0ejfSlAXKwQdV5wsAz_wOEsc9lt1XhMWFleug5mGNKakwYYmOp7I9ULdhhYkWB1fYSTTtav1MsiFNT34xjzOAiYokZttP3271o_hYHJkm0RJuofZrEAqGqQy2FhcHkTHP0Yp4-L6DoPhPedHugDFHTevlfNkFoxUxWn9gQ%3D%3D)

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7df2205e972a4cc8b58b087a5cbee6a2&_e=oSqJDKCpdj2kxk8M7vSSu94knoAGVMZpnAs3zru3lN34rCdj0ShO8kqDfE1yFFV11vP7Quanh5TmQC1ZS688A8GTRiVH3R-1dtzIFUtfKq4DlUwiLrjDERNxUbGwipIPuUrmYSRC9Wgy_xXfU4JTkTOv2Dj-1UxN3slitE_y-7w3VRm_RtK377dtbDpNPyZv5hny0Zq6pTMkJEIF2Q0pXuQ2UIFT1tL1EK1bpP7yRQTe3tTo0ejfSlAXKwQdV5wslpnCVGVpInm-JMHccQVwS9k4xYmsvdVOvWLs2vnZ-D_0Fq8V2j3h0t3zbu6AdaZnwLDnne3v01YKsLPl4MryKyIqAmaWlS_rVF5yonaPp3vj5t7PfSbiao3Ia0KHLR9pHdCHwVmf44iV3AB40fJomw%3D%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

| | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c7289b57560b401ab3337a19fd389ca1&_e=9NwEJd02WnFKrmCzgX3hmb9t1DdNwPbL3b3P_hlvjM0eBjyZAgrb9vKQby6mcKuO9pwXYI1uX00JsvEmFcjL19znO2QXWn6P9miM_8s-_DLDvzWLmR8IsRZtQ8_Fd1DwQZQstveGTXRLoRmMgSja-gjC6fXx776tamN9r1BwS3sV5FtuhVbvgDglo7Pa1apJxV3VYz-X2oRoOSa9tbBu9Huuk5X8rH4TKIIgkQd1QWskFoPoCz2vDjkXTVYtK7K2iSxtpwIoPs0qm0I0HLtZOowSNfK1PuHYiFKeaqi6RVt7oqWioUBigL6o1AFDViz9Ub-iOWVKRychaoOQ4kzc7ewDbwtQfHOOeQbKcQfJ1MNUfDue5ZirhrbDZxHRs1hhRLv38M4VfVpWV_OcOpWMcPlHHywKejAlCq9Wcqs2nYQFlnSa6Myxvbp0u0j2pBNk)
---
**1.6 million.**

That’s how many American children are in Catholic schools nationwide, Peter.

That’s how many kids that benefit from the unique educational opportunities Catholic schools afford.

_**Here’s the problem:**_ _This critical schooling option is on the brink of disappearing in areas where legislation prevents parents from applying their education tax dollars toward their children's Catholic education._
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: SAVE CATHOLIC SCHOOLS**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c7289b57560b401ab3337a19fd389ca1&_e=9NwEJd02WnFKrmCzgX3hmb9t1DdNwPbL3b3P_hlvjM0eBjyZAgrb9vKQby6mcKuO9pwXYI1uX00JsvEmFcjL19znO2QXWn6P9miM_8s-_DLDvzWLmR8IsRZtQ8_Fd1DwQZQstveGTXRLoRmMgSja-gjC6fXx776tamN9r1BwS3sV5FtuhVbvgDglo7Pa1apJxV3VYz-X2oRoOSa9tbBu9Huuk5X8rH4TKIIgkQd1QWskFoPoCz2vDjkXTVYtK7K2iSxtpwIoPs0qm0I0HLtZOgHK_F1VP-vydqcCEWIK7HkexMCw_5628rVYU3-Vfzq9Z2dtG8l7UzKxr-NjKHGcsIgjPr0sSkOCqmd2J6lviOMi8ZkmsjDBYcfn569zUc_jLK__AcGYGc2bLEKwxpXRYZ4y-BuRzPUpPEW-fbKrtwJsU9SesPJOtW_iBPNOUqjA)
---
The potential closure of Catholic schools represents more than just the fading of a cherished American tradition; it signifies a critical blow to educational diversity, especially in communities most in need._**[I AGREE >>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c7289b57560b401ab3337a19fd389ca1&_e=9NwEJd02WnFKrmCzgX3hmb9t1DdNwPbL3b3P_hlvjM0eBjyZAgrb9vKQby6mcKuO9pwXYI1uX00JsvEmFcjL19znO2QXWn6P9miM_8s-_DLDvzWLmR8IsRZtQ8_Fd1DwQZQstveGTXRLoRmMgSja-gjC6fXx776tamN9r1BwS3sV5FtuhVbvgDglo7Pa1apJxV3VYz-X2oRoOSa9tbBu9Huuk5X8rH4TKIIgkQd1QWskFoPoCz2vDjkXTVYtK7K2iSxtpwIoPs0qm0I0HLtZOhKaOGz2I3hiEXKyQvnXpCefvaaqMwlgf-kpTo041hTbhNI-YTKgL6oL-24Bp-ts7Hb6jgFI6WXTLOKFWov6H9HnMZiOo5HLk8O9NHv9iYQthyt3QHqviqCaQPe3YCV6CfwZnN77-ISOaS2rUKVBMd3HEM5ALwozAcvHmV_3Na9m)**_

**Peter, Catholic schools serve a broader purpose than many realize.**

Contrary to the perception that private schools only cater to wealthy communities, Catholic schools often establish themselves based on the need for dependable educational alternatives, not the financial status of the communities they serve.

Many of these institutions stand as the sole beacon of hope for families stuck in underperforming public school districts. _We're championing the cause of school choice because we believe every family deserves access to quality educational options, including Catholic Schools. _
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: EMPOWER PARENTS TO CHOOSE CATHOLIC SCHOOLS**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c7289b57560b401ab3337a19fd389ca1&_e=9NwEJd02WnFKrmCzgX3hmb9t1DdNwPbL3b3P_hlvjM0eBjyZAgrb9vKQby6mcKuO9pwXYI1uX00JsvEmFcjL19znO2QXWn6P9miM_8s-_DLDvzWLmR8IsRZtQ8_Fd1DwQZQstveGTXRLoRmMgSja-gjC6fXx776tamN9r1BwS3sV5FtuhVbvgDglo7Pa1apJxV3VYz-X2oRoOSa9tbBu9Huuk5X8rH4TKIIgkQd1QWskFoPoCz2vDjkXTVYtK7K2iSxtpwIoPs0qm0I0HLtZOpF3zFEdhS4d3bwBMZx-KiAQ0eBksnn2nmJNEUXBg8giD6YHcwhQWUy9BYhny-TgauKFE7pqXEaCliPwPRr6JcAVRrkSI93dv2w5XgS-UuMivItBXjfttqRekwHptTCiZW8Bg9M5wLJ_sSy3kmZPPjXMLuRxEhrdliMhXpdhMBOp)
---
At the **American Federation for Children Growth Fund** , we understand that educational needs are as diverse as the students themselves.

Our mission is to ensure _every_ child can find an educational setting that meets those needs, whether it’s a Catholic school or another educational model. The diversity of choice is essential, and it starts with empowering families to make those choices.

[**Stand with us by signing our petition to urge lawmakers to open the doors to Catholic education for all families.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c7289b57560b401ab3337a19fd389ca1&_e=9NwEJd02WnFKrmCzgX3hmb9t1DdNwPbL3b3P_hlvjM0eBjyZAgrb9vKQby6mcKuO9pwXYI1uX00JsvEmFcjL19znO2QXWn6P9miM_8s-_DLDvzWLmR8IsRZtQ8_Fd1DwQZQstveGTXRLoRmMgSja-gjC6fXx776tamN9r1BwS3sV5FtuhVbvgDglo7Pa1apJxV3VYz-X2oRoOSa9tbBu9Huuk5X8rH4TKIIgkQd1QWskFoPoCz2vDjkXTVYtK7K2iSxtpwIoPs0qm0I0HLtZOpN2yWZysT5waM-V_2l2jxQ9_rpWOuiEt4LNnFbAmClYQOK3gISQEMV_t_KgK-N4mW-XCSGIXFqWIYybxdCmaAKqO3SzJ4H24EEIWs_BePUaRjLUMevk62Jpwy3_JT1YhGPAcUB9a41lQwOX7v_fGq-QvKPxsaHqv4OxqIbvsPkp)

With gratitude,
Rebekah Bydlak

name: Amber Padora
subject: Boebert wants a nightmarish future for our children
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:
I really don’t love speaking negatively about other women, but when a woman like Lauren Boebert wants to carpetbag into our district, strip my daughter of her right to make her own choices about her body, and support policies that make it more likely for my children to be shot while at school... well I just can’t be silent.
__ | | | [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=daae938e27f74497b52ae87f620506e0&_e=8GDfg7fW6tCQ-uwjx-EVsh5Lp-CLl4Dk6uT212Vx6X39jO-6nR10DKZtP-iTUpek3c17229J-9mphhmlcj05jciVQZRqr1dXETcO979GaP-MoV5e4gh7KavjifWW6pYvdD3KdnD4Tx_IokK-5_mYOckdCiqncr3INRyv4lCCqNhWU3PtLs-2T5ZbsKFdLMp_mho44ZMIjZ4-sdjOmyKBYfapK9Os-RBwsMMgLOTkLjO0P4jWQZaF6deNjQAZ1B0Dmdg8Lg2MEf0-65vqZyfhBq0CVgodSa67qgKANiYOOQaiJ1qNMcwP0QiqKG6SZ1X04cyshrrPPUboVubCrHdh8xknUC20JWEK9VcM-oK6SUsRRgy0RLno18JTB8x3KUw0F1bbnn6Bbs-QNPWIuGfJeQ%3D%3D) Hi friends, it’s Amber Padora, John’s wife. I really don’t love speaking negatively about other women, but when a woman like Lauren Boebert wants to carpetbag into our district, strip my daughter of her right to make her own choices about her body, and support policies that make it more likely for my children to be shot while at school... well I just can’t be silent. Because this is who Lauren Boebert is. She supports policies that would lead to a nightmarish future for my children. **She does not believe in climate change. She wants to see a national abortion ban. She supports more guns without restrictions. name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: The heart and soul of our campaign
body:
Arizonans are so excited to support a young, progressive and effective leader who listens to and looks out for them. They're fired up and ready to fight alongside us.
Peter,
I wanted to reach out personally before our mid-month fundraising deadline.
My team and I are working around the clock to educate our community about their voting rights, get people registered, and get across what's at stake in this critical election.
Everywhere we go, our message is resonating. Arizonans are so excited to support a young, progressive and effective leader who listens to and looks out for them. They're fired up and ready to fight alongside us.
**This grassroots work is the heart and soul of our campaign, Peter. It's the only way we'll win the people-first policies that make a real and urgent difference in our community.**
Policies like historic climate action, long-overdue housing reform, transformative investments in education and infrastructure, and world-class healthcare for every single person. That's what I've fought for and delivered throughout my entire career, and it’s exactly what you can expect from me every day in Congress.

Peter,

In a moment, [I’m going to ask you to split a $15 donation between my campaign and Defeat Republicans,](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85098614/473662806/509726796?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240516_1_3&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc4ZWM2ZjI1LWU1MTMtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjE0ZGFkMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=q_yB9qe36rBGKphqRGSYeum4fhdndSnb5X29HM64ydY=) but first, I want to explain why your contribution is so important.

In places prone to hurricanes and wildfires, insurers are grappling with massive risk as the climate crisis makes extreme weather events much more common and much more severe. A major insurance collapse would trigger huge consequences for the stability of the entire economy, especially for middle-class families trying to insure their biggest investment – their homes.

I’ve been raising the alarm on the climate crisis for years, warning of the economic risks caused by the environmental effects of climate change. I’m using every tool available to me to fight the climate crisis and the greedy fossil fuel industry, which is making money hand over fist at the expense of our planet.

My methane fee, which cracks down on the wasteful methane leaks from the fossil fuel industry that are responsible for an outsized amount of climate change, became law in the Inflation Reduction Act. And I pressed hard on the administration to adopt a serious governmentwide “social cost of carbon” – an economic term for factoring the actual harms and costs of fossil fuels into all kinds of decisions.

It’s clear we know pretty well how to solve climate change. But because of the fossil fuel industry and its dark-money machine, we haven’t been able to lead the planet and our economy to the safe zone yet.

**And because of my work in Washington to stop the fossil fuel industry from baking our planet to the point of no return, I’m their biggest adversary, and they’ll do everything they can to keep me from winning re-election this year.**

But I know inaction is the most expensive route we can take, Peter.

In places prone to hurricanes and wildfires, insurers are grappling with massive risk as the climate crisis makes extreme weather events much more common and much more severe. I’ve been raising the alarm on the climate crisis for years, warning of the economic risks caused by the environmental effects of climate change. I’m using every tool available to me to fight the climate crisis and the greedy fossil fuel industry, which is making money hand over fist at the expense of our planet. My methane fee, which cracks down on the wasteful methane leaks from the fossil fuel industry that are responsible for an outsized amount of climate change, became law in the Inflation Reduction Act. It’s clear we know pretty well how to solve climate change. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: July could tell us everything
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

There’s a massive battle raging within the Republican Party right now.

_Will the GOP stand strong for Life?_

_Or will the Republican Party** _run away from the abortion issue_** – and only seek to save a few percent of the hundreds of thousands of preborn babies who are killed by abortion every year?_

What if I told you that we’ll both find out this July – specifically the 15th through the 18th?

Those are the dates of the upcoming Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, where GOP convention delegates will craft and finalize its new platform – the first since _Roe v. Wade’s_ reversal.

And this platform will lay the foundation for the Republican Party at least for the next four years.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-y/) **Pro-Life Friend, if you and I want the Republican Party to stand strongly for Life, we have to take action – NOW.**

That’s why I’ve decided to follow in the footsteps of my political mentor – Phyllis Schlafly – to launch GOP for Life.

**No, I’m not stepping away from _Students for Life!_**

But I am preparing to lead the fight for Life at the Republican National Convention!

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your STAND4LIFE! Petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-j/).**

As you’ll see, these petitions simply insist that your state’s Republican National Committeeman and Committeewoman – and all the other Convention delegates from your state:

• DO NOT WEAKEN THE GOP PLATFORM ON LIFE;

• Publicly support including passage of a federal _Life at Conception Act_ to abolish abortion nationwide in the GOP Platform.
My goal is to make sure that every Convention delegate understands that REFUSING to **_STAND4LIFE_** could cost them big this November.

Sadly, I’m already growing worried that could happen.

If November turns out to be as close as many polls suggest, _turnout is going to be key_.

_And I’ve heard from a number of pro-lifers who are disappointed that all President Trump and some other Republicans are saying abortion isn’t a federal issue OR saying they will only consider a 15-week _Abortion Prevention Law_._

Some tell us we’re supposed to be excited that 6% of preborn babies could be saved under legislation like this.

But the truth is, it won’t even be that many.

And even those backing these bills know that.

_Do they really expect abortionists to abide by the honor system – and not kill a preborn baby that’s a day, week, month, or few months “over the line?”_

They know better, Pro-Life Friend.

We just need politicians with the GUTS to stand up and say . . .

. . . abortion is wrong . . .

. . . it’s killing an innocent human being . . .

. . . and it should be abolished!

Now, THAT would get people fired up!

**But if the Republican Party won’t say it, who will?**

The good news is, RNC Convention Delegates aren't slick politicians who’ve had D.C. consultants in their ears for years.

They’re people just like you and me who are committed to changing America for the better – including standing for Life.

_But there are going to be snakes who try to water-down the platform in hopes they can ensure there will be**NO** pro-life party in America anymore_.

They will try to convince other delegates to take a bite of the apple . . .

And sometimes slick words trick good people.

That’s why I’m going to fight this.

And I’m asking you to stand with me by signing your **[STAND4LIFE! Petition](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-i/).**

**[And, if at all possible, please agree to your most generous contribution of $1,000, $500, or $250 to help me gather as many of these petitions as I possibly can](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-d/)!**

**[Or, if that’s too much, could you agree to $100, $50, or $25](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-h/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, states are busy selecting their Republican National Convention Delegates now.

So, now is when we need to take action – not when Convention Delegates are sealed off from the rest of America!

**[Please sign your STAND4LIFE! Petition today, and agree to your most generous contribution of $1,000, $500, $250, $100, $50, or $25 TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-k/)!**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – At the upcoming Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, GOP Delegates will craft and finalize its new platform – the first since _Roe v. Wade’s_ reversal.

What happens here will go a long way to deciding whether or not America has ANY pro-life political party anymore.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your STAND4LIFE! Petition right away and agree to your most generous contribution of $1,000, $500, $250, $100, $50, or $25 TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gozjl-duchtdja-u/)!**

Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Explore these great works at home
body:
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv6rpvu4nj4ssb0oh8jeokl70puhtbcf0hlh2okg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj66o71cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Recently, I read about a Massachusetts high school teacher who posted on social media that she’s: “Very proud to say we got the _Odyssey_ removed from the curriculum this year!” Homer and the legendary Odysseus are just the latest casualties in a systematic purge of classic literature and stories from school curriculums. These cancelations rob our young of classic tales of adventure and friendship, where young people can learn timeless truths about the world and how best to live—something many Americans cannot agree on in the first place. Books like these are rare, and the best of them are revised, ignored, or removed in most of today’s schools. In response, Hillsdale College launched a free online course entitled **“Classic Children’s Literature.”** Perhaps you’ve had a chance to watch a few lectures. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsrskmovfla3rdciurfuoc2tp36fqka9aivo76u8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj66o71cjh2bs) **Today, I’m excited to tell you that the course is now available on DVD! And you can reserve your copy today.** The box-set is an excellent gift for parents, homeschool families, and anyone who cherishes an exciting and profound story. **" Classic Children's Literature"** explores some of the greatest works of children's literature from Aesop and the classic fairy tale stories through the works of A.A. Milne, Robert Louis Stevenson, and more. In this course, you’ll learn how these great books delight audiences of all ages, produce a sense of wonder, and teach timeless lessons to the young and old alike. The DVD box-set includes lessons on _Beauty and the Beast, The Snow Queen, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Treasure Island_ , and more. This course has brought great joy to my family, as it has inspired us to read through the classic works covered in this course together. I hope you can share this same experience with your loved ones as you learn more about what makes these beloved stories so important. **You can get your DVD box-set of “Classic Children’s Literature” by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 to Hillsdale College using this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-classic-childrens-literature-today](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp2g6mr50pj3en9jcrgvd73akhk1goccju5ske0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj66o71cjh2bs)** Thank you again for your support of Hillsdale College and for partnering with us to educate our fellow citizens, especially our youngest citizens. Without you, Hillsdale could not offer these courses free of charge to any person willing to learn. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8ili9hv7hadt6uk62o1vksqlbm8iubqe9vcq2qo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj69p30cth2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh79rf0ao2fn184865la5b57qf2pe2pvh3q05k7g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj69p30cth2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zftfm2t66oqm0889a7hbg40hjk2occ0dgn8l3ntg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj69p30cth2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdu0k00p5e0cfcu08u17vcfkc34k02m783f9ut98_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjj69p30cth2bs)**

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Explore these great works at home
body:
| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zthl1lkh8osn6droee8fmloiug9b703gj068pnco_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o31cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, Classic children's literature is being ignored and eliminated from our nation's classrooms at an alarming rate. Beloved classics like _The Wind in the Willows_ , _Treasure Island_ , and _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ are just a few of the foundational books that are rarely being taught to our nation's children today. Not only does this rob young people of classic tales of adventure and friendship, but they also rob children of fundamental lessons about the world and how best to live.
---
| | That's why Hillsdale College released a free online course titled **" Classic Children's Literature."** Perhaps you've had a chance to watch a few lectures. **Today, I 'm excited to tell you that the course is now available on DVD! And you can get your very own box set right now!** [**" Classic Children's Literature"**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6g7evq1sgb6km2grf217fbvcrp5fut4a05tsk88_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o31cph2bs) explores some of the greatest works of children's literature, from Aesop and the classic fairy tales to _Treasure Island_ and _Winnie-the-Pooh_ , and so much more. When you get your box set today, you will not only delight your family, but also evoke a sense of wonder while teaching timeless lessons to the young and old alike.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkulsaa1q1abfb019ucq1o32smv2tjnqqp1djcm8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o31cph2bs)
---
| | Speaking from my own experience, this course has brought great joy to my family. It has inspired us to read the classic works covered in this course together. And I hope you can share this same experience with your loved ones as you learn more about what makes these beloved stories so important. **You can get your DVD box set of "Classic Children's Literature" by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 to Hillsdale College using this secure link:** [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-classic-childrens-literature-today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk46c1c5r4l489iomn9nvqra7vfvcpo992soskmo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o31cph2bs) And when you do, you'll also help expand nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, such as:
* Increasing the number of students taking free online courses.
* Growing the readership of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty.
* Restoring excellence to K-12 education through an American classical curriculum.
* Promoting constitutional education through social media and the radio.

Thank you again for your support of Hillsdale College and for partnering with us to educate our fellow citizens, especially our youngest citizens. Without you, Hillsdale could not offer these courses free of charge to anyone willing to learn. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College P.S. These DVDs are an excellent gift for parents, homeschool families, and anyone who cherishes these timeless stories. **Get your DVD box-set of "Classic Children's Literature" by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 to Hillsdale College using this secure link: ** [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-classic-childrens-literature-today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvffg825a9vnnlvommcj4kcqkb143k8mlrjsdm00_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o31cph2bs)

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z66oqianck9hvmiu0m3ph83htlgj7ftm4m3dluqg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o36c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zre0m8f2lac7atv9lt01i3cui464c6pd47er4gio_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o36c1h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6b9djfju308umoh80ag33bac7oo6fc3qg63d370_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o36c1h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zspdj6o2odei5ik98v9jk1h1rdpv6lb1f4apb76g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cjgm0o36c1h2bs)**

American Cornerstone Institute

undermine the Supreme Court...

Fellow
Patriot,

This is

on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the
unborn. And today I need your help.

I know
you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to
overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement
will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won.

Nothing
could be further from the truth-the fight for life is only just
beginning!

Right
now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the
Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice
democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at
the expense of taxpayers like you.

We cannot
allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority
of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that
abortion should be unrestricted.

We must
stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we
don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will
continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to
advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of
the American family.

Today,
I'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe
the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to
the pledge I have linked below:

principled citizens who are uniting to protect the unborn and
refusing to be silenced by a vocal minority of radicalized
fanatics.

I will do
everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the
spread of the Left's anti-life ideology. Will you take a minute
to stand with me by signing this pledge now?

I'd like
to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can
save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben
Carson

These cancelations rob our young of classic tales of adventure and friendship, where young people can learn timeless truths about the world and how best to live—something many Americans cannot agree on in the first place. Books like these are rare, and the best of them are revised, ignored, or removed in most of today’s schools. In response, Hillsdale College launched a free online course entitled **“Classic Children’s Literature.”** Perhaps you’ve had a chance to watch a few lectures. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lWOhI__17F-1gXXseav95g~~/AARclAA~/RgRoKao8P0TsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtY2xhc3NpYy1jaGlsZHJlbnMtbGl0ZXJhdHVyZS1kdmQtdG9kYXk_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNsYXNzaWNfY2hpbGRyZW5zX2xpdF9kdmQmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLUNCLTIwMjQwNTE3JnNjPTAwNDYyTjAyNDJMMTVET0RFRVMmdXRtX3Rlcm09Y2FuY2VsaG9tZXJXA3NwY0IKZka4GUdmFh9gs1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) **Today, I’m excited to tell you that the course is now available on DVD! And you can reserve your copy today.** The box-set is an excellent gift for parents, homeschool families, and anyone who cherishes an exciting and profound story. **" Classic Children's Literature"** explores some of the greatest works of children's literature from Aesop and the classic fairy tale stories through the works of A.A. Milne, Robert Louis Stevenson, and more. In this course, you’ll learn how these great books delight audiences of all ages, produce a sense of wonder, and teach timeless lessons to the young and old alike. The DVD box-set includes lessons on _Beauty and the Beast, The Snow Queen, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Treasure Island_ , and more. This course has brought great joy to my family, as it has inspired us to read through the classic works covered in this course together. I hope you can share this same experience with your loved ones as you learn more about what makes these beloved stories so important. **You can get your DVD box-set of “Classic Children’s Literature” by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 to Hillsdale College using this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-classic-childrens-literature-today](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lWOhI__17F-1gXXseav95g~~/AARclAA~/RgRoKao8P0TsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtY2xhc3NpYy1jaGlsZHJlbnMtbGl0ZXJhdHVyZS1kdmQtdG9kYXk_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNsYXNzaWNfY2hpbGRyZW5zX2xpdF9kdmQmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLUNCLTIwMjQwNTE3JnNjPTAwNDYyTjAyNDJMMTVET0RFRVMmdXRtX3Rlcm09Y2FuY2VsaG9tZXJXA3NwY0IKZka4GUdmFh9gs1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** Thank you again for your support of Hillsdale College and for partnering with us to educate our fellow citizens, especially our youngest citizens. body:
This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/t7hBjqjo64FnvsgBaBj5Ag~~/AARclAA~/RgRoKbKsP0TtaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtY2xhc3NpYy1jaGlsZHJlbnMtbGl0ZXJhdHVyZS1kdmQtdG9kYXk_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNsYXNzaWNfY2hpbGRyZW5zX2xpdF9kdmQmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDUxNyZzYz0wMDQ2Mk4wMjQyTDE1RE9ERUVTJnV0bV90ZXJtPWNhbmNlbGhvbWVyVwNzcGNCCmZGThpHZhU8eFdSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Fellow American, Recently, I read about a Massachusetts high school teacher who posted on social media that she’s: “Very proud to say we got the _Odyssey_ removed from the curriculum this year!” Homer and the legendary Odysseus are just the latest casualties in a systematic purge of classic literature and stories from school curriculums. These cancelations rob our young of classic tales of adventure and friendship, where young people can learn timeless truths about the world and how best to live—something many Americans cannot agree on in the first place. Books like these are rare, and the best of them are revised, ignored, or removed in most of today’s schools. In response, Hillsdale College launched a free online course entitled **“Classic Children’s Literature.”** Perhaps you’ve had a chance to watch a few lectures. [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/t7hBjqjo64FnvsgBaBj5Ag~~/AARclAA~/RgRoKbKsP0TtaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtY2xhc3NpYy1jaGlsZHJlbnMtbGl0ZXJhdHVyZS1kdmQtdG9kYXk_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNsYXNzaWNfY2hpbGRyZW5zX2xpdF9kdmQmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDUxNyZzYz0wMDQ2Mk4wMjQyTDE1RE9ERUVTJnV0bV90ZXJtPWNhbmNlbGhvbWVyVwNzcGNCCmZGThpHZhU8eFdSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) **Today, I’m excited to tell you that the course is now available on DVD! And you can reserve your copy today.** The box-set is an excellent gift for parents, homeschool families, and anyone who cherishes an exciting and profound story. **" Classic Children's Literature"** explores some of the greatest works of children's literature from Aesop and the classic fairy tale stories through the works of A.A. Milne, Robert Louis Stevenson, and more. In this course, you’ll learn how these great books delight audiences of all ages, produce a sense of wonder, and teach timeless lessons to the young and old alike. The DVD box-set includes lessons on _Beauty and the Beast, The Snow Queen, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Treasure Island_ , and more. This course has brought great joy to my family, as it has inspired us to read through the classic works covered in this course together. I hope you can share this same experience with your loved ones as you learn more about what makes these beloved stories so important. **You can get your DVD box-set of “Classic Children’s Literature” by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 to Hillsdale College using this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-classic-childrens-literature-today](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/t7hBjqjo64FnvsgBaBj5Ag~~/AARclAA~/RgRoKbKsP0TtaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtY2xhc3NpYy1jaGlsZHJlbnMtbGl0ZXJhdHVyZS1kdmQtdG9kYXk_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNsYXNzaWNfY2hpbGRyZW5zX2xpdF9kdmQmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDUxNyZzYz0wMDQ2Mk4wMjQyTDE1RE9ERUVTJnV0bV90ZXJtPWNhbmNlbGhvbWVyVwNzcGNCCmZGThpHZhU8eFdSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Thank you again for your support of Hillsdale College and for partnering with us to educate our fellow citizens, especially our youngest citizens. Without you, Hillsdale could not offer these courses free of charge to any person willing to learn. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

A new analysis indicates the range of incomes needed to be considered [middle class in every U.S. state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu7CAUAL8GOizAPK4LitvQbdqU1jEc1kTYrAyx5b-PNnXqkUaj-XzMD8gl788P2ND1VGcIPZ84ayYsk2pWNLqEKHGk6IQVelITt4quDkLCZdSTjsjBaAMhWbAAQcRlhKRodpJLxbWw_J82Wg1aWxiN5NEi2AkNURxj7vUYvmre-4qp3PXEYwh1o8Wtvb8aGf8T6Yn013UNYV_CGxLp32oiPddEemGI9A0KHDfbESNG1itbkG05xoIsFGiN5Z3hicfNvhtrHToOa98KPVx8XbmU3Iwlij83yOU3oP-54ycAAP__qzxhDw), ranging from a low of $35,323 in Mississippi to a high of nearly $197,000 in Maryland. subject: My bill just passed…
body:
Peter, I am excited to report that we took historic action this week during National Police Week. As a retired detective in the New York City Police Department, I know firsthand the critical function our police officers
[](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mbtyhl-dytjdljkkt-r/) Peter, I am excited to report that we took historic action this week during National Police Week.As a retired detective in the New York City Police Department, I know firsthand the critical function our police officers fulfill in keeping our communities safe. **Today, the House passed a bill I introduced to address the problems our officers are facing due to current border policies.** The bill requires Attorney General Merrick Garland to take up a comprehensive report on the effects of the wave of illegal immigration across the southern border on federal, state, and local law enforcement officials and how this wave of illegal immigration affects:-> The estimated resource cost in addressing the illegal immigration that is pouring in.-> The extent to which such resources are unavailable to the law enforcement agencies.-> Exposure of police to harmful substances, such as fentanyl, which are being smuggled into the United States.-> Any injuries suffered by officers in their line of duty.-> The overall morale of the law enforcement officers.As I said before, _" Thanks to the open border policies of President Biden and Secretary Mayorkas, law enforcement agencies across the country are being overwhelmed by the millions of migrants and large quantities of dangerous narcotics like fentanyl flowing into the United States."_**The legislation was a critical step in understanding and addressing the impact of current border policy on the law enforcement community.** Therefore, it will be valuable to provide data and information that we can use to advocate for the resources that our working officers need to secure to protect our communities.**Thank you for your continuous support in our quest to ensure the principles of safety, justice, and law and order.****[If you are able, please consider contributing to our campaign. Your support not only enables us to continue our advocacy but also helps strengthen our commitment to enhancing the safety and well-being of our communities.](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mbtyhl-dytjdljkkt-y/)** Sincerely,

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Liberty Delivered is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=abf4739cba544952ad54dbfeac4aaedf&_e=vg0-L-axRI0b0HKdzPv2VjqSW253WUQ98QoKvhHZ--Vy8HCJEyDvxTmC-W6LPTRh3-lB3DIqjG8_-buipAKbFxGebajz5oD2z_HgT-BJ97_vxkkz94Uzn0ItNhOI7TuWut_0aA4KYO19nzdYHJz1m6OWX1Cp9Pd7B-3jTpLPUlBHUyYuRlNSI-e-bMZaEHt7gN8pTyU0RZs_Y1r3Odtl5Jlc3ovkMFuBsEfy8ty0-79DJjPBipz7EAYLymF68rVCpUzdzLjgDu0jNuecqq7j2TgvVDajI8Iis4mOhg0Z8oFxAclxP8efTzOzCSMTwVFfLDJdT6CwKMULSk2ZgWm9g16jeUHEbqz8XrfsS3r0KSbp2d3c_H9877xI7GgGGIdTLrg6UcR3akiDwf4yZAwRfmCf9USGlB2bS9hIKzK1s8A%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=abf4739cba544952ad54dbfeac4aaedf&_e=vg0-L-axRI0b0HKdzPv2VjqSW253WUQ98QoKvhHZ--Vy8HCJEyDvxTmC-W6LPTRh3-lB3DIqjG8_-buipAKbFxGebajz5oD2z_HgT-BJ97_vxkkz94Uzn0ItNhOI7TuWut_0aA4KYO19nzdYHJz1m6OWX1Cp9Pd7B-3jTpLPUlBHUyYuRlNSI-e-bMZaEHt7gN8pTyU0RZs_Y1r3Odtl5Jlc3ovkMFuBsEfy8ty0-79DJjPBipz7EAYLymF68rVCpUzdzLjgDu0jNuecqq7j2XZx_Ij8crossHmRmgEIz-k3NmtPOlxnxD7H7cY_KuLGVZiT13mcpdlhTGmoRvW8YBHkU1Ru2hQvhSuawIeq_9O2PVXF_PD8xRqGqV93VJAraBsSk9ntR88ZCYn-L6jDpJMRhFAvd7bhYVzewNPdIJk%3D) If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of **" The Second World Wars"** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=abf4739cba544952ad54dbfeac4aaedf&_e=vg0-L-axRI0b0HKdzPv2VjqSW253WUQ98QoKvhHZ--Vy8HCJEyDvxTmC-W6LPTRh3-lB3DIqjG8_-buipAKbFxGebajz5oD2z_HgT-BJ97_vxkkz94Uzn0ItNhOI7TuWut_0aA4KYO19nzdYHJz1m6OWX1Cp9Pd7B-3jTpLPUlBHUyYuRlNSI-e-bMZaEHt7gN8pTyU0RZs_Y1r3Odtl5Jlc3ovkMFuBsEfy8ty0-79DJjPBipz7EAYLymF68rVCpUzdzLjgDu0jNuecqq7j2RspVqWW1d3GQAeCz_BU4r8Gek0H8Zdaif8UsVmBHgjq7uixwGzLzG7M8ehKZ8eAniWzArc7GXHD2DASbFAFWK3KaNiRParWSszvRZMVljxJOzq4IP6cev1a3hVdvVhvs7BzLXufcVTBrdBXPAKezYI%3D)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Liberty Delivered is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=605ea497adc6401a8cffdd3ce04ce16c&_e=evetK0Iuw1JmtLcGD8tRXPBKSlgdhDQzP-WdkqOc83TrlYXE34ugfqk_rvMHSdEbXZUHDOUeVpx2nKkoWwRUbi5GurwxodEPM6QuHetZQFY8JHELT5wncPhsMO_5LS1FzzIRnWU_QbEFh_HeD6H5586U6aUIW34PPzFLmg4gwerOnFZDkVjwKAGlGUpJiB-KnwlhcZpLrL92vU8-UugWFDHsxGV1-4J5yxcZxWxLgv-xqJbESPzCOT4btSlk4gDDovWpmDuzRe69Ma-A95o2yAgbB46vEPcX4guIQ1O2qlMhNif899kYSOzWnijtTzKkTe2NRDcmSyzrhQ26H_zggcq490B0PWQ-Us61_TVwsZCZniErib1ZusrKIjWTyzb1OQkERZoOJaAP8motA-AVMIifziRvZEYcnFItki9IpZA%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**

subject: CTA May 17th: Support the SAVE Act and Secure American Elections
body:
Closing loopholes on noncitizen voting
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** A pinky promise is not enough to ensure that every vote cast in a federal election is from a citizen of the United States. Neither is simply checking a box. Yet, that seems to be what Democrats are defending when they attack Representative Chip Roy and Senator Mike Lee's bill, the [Safeguarding American Voter Eligibility (SAVE)](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edaa "http://www.onlycitizensvotecoalition.com/") Act.
Last week, Speaker Johnson, Senator Lee, Congressman Roy, myself, and others spoke in support of this bill at press conference. Our friend Cleta Mitchell also announced a new coalition that we are helping to organize called [Only Citizens Vote Coalition.](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edac)
You can watch the [entire press conference](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edae "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/only-citizens-vote-press-conference/") if you missed it, and you can watch [my individual remarks](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edb0 "my individual remarks") as well. I also wrote an [op-ed discussing](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edb2) the importance of getting out ahead of what could be a disaster for our election system.
While the SAVE Act doesn't make it "illegal" for noncitizens to vote in federal elections - because that is already against the law - but it does require proof of citizenship at the time of voter registration, which is **_not_** currently required by law.** A **[**new study**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edb4)** found that between 10%-27% of noncitizen adults are registered to vote.** This is a staggering number that could have dire consequences for our elections.
**ACTION** What can **_you_** do? Call your U.S. representative and senators and tell them to pass the SAVE Act, because Americans, like you, overwhelmingly demand that **_Only Citizens Vote in U.S. elections!_**
In fact, in your remarks when you call, you can mention the [results from a poll](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edb6) we fielded with McLaughlin and Associates in February 2024. We found that 87% agree that proof of United States citizenship should be required to register to vote in American elections, and 86% agree that only United States citizens should be allowed to vote in elections in America. [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edb8) **** ************

In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97948b737562/1edb97948b57edbe) **** ************

But equally infuriating — O thers in the race have echoed a concerning rhetoric about "states' rights", which only dilutes the urgency of protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _🚨Time to Get to Work!_**
---
Friends, As we approach these summer months we are preparing for a long and exciting road, with lots of hard work ahead. It is going to take all of us working together, door knocking, phone banking, putting up yard signs, and much more to ensure Republican victories statewide! _**So, consider this a call to action!**_ Now is the time to sign up and get to work! We are looking for full time staff, interns, and volunteers, to _[_join the team_](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/f531e6fc581ee74fc3d6b838967d376c/40313)_. If you would like to learn more about how to get involved with the Indiana GOP, reach out to Sam Orrell at sorrell@indiana.gop. We have something for everybody! If you are interested in volunteering with the top of the ticket in Indiana, you can sign up to volunteer for Mike Braun for Indiana [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/0be30a68985b55b5c3d6b838967d376c/40313), or you can to sign up to help Jim Banks for Senate [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/5550f7b5e3733018c3d6b838967d376c/40313). If you want to get involved at the local level, you can [reach out to your county chairs](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/ffdd1d43b3926553c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and see how you can help. Your county party leadership needs help to power all of the local organizations that are foundational to all of our campaign efforts. There are so many ways to help Republicans win in November - please take the time and sign up today! Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---

# _🚆 Gov. Holcomb Announces Completion of Double Track Project On The South Shore _
---
---
---
| | **Governor Eric Holcomb **[announced](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/6cb5e1f554104999c3d6b838967d376c/40313) alongside fellow Republicans the completion of the Double Track Project on the South Shore Line. **What he’s saying** : “One hundred years later, this Double Track Project will continue to transform Northwest Indiana for generations to come,” Gov. Holcomb said. “This game-changing project is yet another example of how the State of Indiana continues to make targeted investments that attract talent and commercial investment that in turn helps our communities take it to their next level.” \- **Gov. Holcomb** said in [press release](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/5e8cd5fba9bf5d3ec3d6b838967d376c/40313).** **What else is he doing** [announced](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/2046cd1e7a431403c3d6b838967d376c/40313) this year's Governor's #STEM Team.
* To stay up-to-date, follow **Gov. Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/b21422d870881f1dc3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/8cfa3519d30d3ee3c3d6b838967d376c/40313).

# 🏝️❌Vacations are Cancelled Due to Bidenflation✈️💸
---
As we enter the summer season and gear up for family vacations and other seasonal activities, we wanted to remind you all to budget appropriately for what may be the most expensive summer of our lifetimes. Bidenflation has made it impossible for many to take a summer vacation, or even enjoy simple outings with their children. How has Bidenomics impacted your summer vacation plans?
* Average costs for lodging have gone up an additional $24 a night.
* Tickets for movies, concerts, and theaters cost $33 more per ticket.
* Taking a road trip? Under Bidenomics you are spending $259 more for every 100 gallons you put in your vehicle.
* A $200 trip to the grocery store costs an additional $48 in Biden’s economy.

A family of 4 can expect to spend an additional $663 on a 3-day vacation that they wouldn’t have spent 4 years ago in Trump’s economy. The information above was collected from [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/8ee9865319119d0dc3d6b838967d376c/40313)[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/978584597aae55b7c3d6b838967d376c/40313)[Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/676a2c6ebead05edc3d6b838967d376c/40313) And how are Americans dealing with Bidenflation? A [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/79ff7a5774fa3058c3d6b838967d376c/40313)[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/1ccbd7d12c270abac3d6b838967d376c/40313)[Survey](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/fce541579e2c2563c3d6b838967d376c/40313) [of Americans](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/3912389bbf9de766c3d6b838967d376c/40313)[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/035ce66d3cf8c5783947229f28c3afba/2ee15f4e55fecd81c3d6b838967d376c/40313) says...
* 1 in 3 Americans are willing to go into debt to pay for vacation this year.
* 47% of Americans plan to skip their summer vacation, 65% citing affordability as the main issue.
* 26% plan to use a credit card and carry the balance over multiple billing cycles in order to go on vacation.
* 60% of Gen Z and Millennials plan on using debt to pay for Vacation

The top of the ticket in November presents a clear choice. We can either continue the Biden path of crippling inflation, watching our real average wages decline, or we can correct our trajectory by electing President Trump.

| What West Michigan Leaders Are Saying About Paul Hudson... --Local Elected Officials Coalesce Around Hudson to Defeat Hillary Scholten--
---
| From the start of this race, we've been focused on creating a broad coalition of conservative supporters who want to see common-sense change in Washington.
Over the past month, the campaign has rolled out endorsements from 15 strong West Michigan leaders from every corner of the district, including State Senators Roger Victory, Jon Bumstead, and Rick Outman, State House Reps. Curt VanderWall, Bryan Posthumus, local leaders like Kent County Board of Commissioner Chair Stan Stek and many more:

* U.S. Congressman Jack Bergman
* Greg Madura (Alpine Twp. Supervisor)
* Kent County Treasurer Pete MacGregor
* Former State Rep and Small Business Owner Tommy Brann
* Kent County Commissioner Matt Kallman
* Kent County Commissioner Ben Greene
* Steve Grimm (Cannon Twp. Supervisor)
* Mike DeVries (Grand Rapids Twp. Supervisor)
* James Craig (Former Detroit Police Chief)

The support of local leaders is critical to success in November, and we're very proud to have all of them on Team Hudson!
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FqhNmoZPwz7HvZgwJ_3c-zF4WMdXhnOpf2a9BeJr6t5v2NKHNGMU33p-q5bUKPTyRM75I3zAQGKmdYL5hCtFHSwOM5LNIX9vp8kKLtbsTSmML97s00TCgB7FNalUOU_CfC_asYvibPncjJrgCxeXlHvTAl8ce5y5&c=bighNJf9WDbQbWKXH7xYFxdZvpBkuyX0bKMnXLBcmHhc6_HCrVDDxw==&ch=VQH-oIoPc-GyFnm968buCx1zbQuBdhB6-qXJQaX-LLfLYl5Kt12rRA==)
---

# Common Sense Principles
"[I]t's good news to have a person like Paul Hudson seeking to be our congressman. Our values are his values ... I support Paul Hudson's campaign because it is based on common-sense principles and a return to fiscal responsibility." \- State Rep Curt VanderWall

# Fiscal Conservative West Michigan Needs
"I'm proud to endorse Paul Hudson for Congress in Michigan's Third because without trusted fiscal conservatives like him, I see no end to this out of control federal government spending ... West Michigan deserves someone who wants to let taxpayers keep more of their hard earned money, and it excites me to see someone fresh like Paul step up to the plate." - Senator Jon Bumstead
"...[A]dd my voice to the growing group of West Michigan Republicans who believe Paul Hudson should be our nominee against our current congressional representative... Paul Hudson is the fiscal conservative West Michigan desperately needs in Congress." - State Senator Rick Outman
The Right Person... "I've seen first hand Paul's hard work and dedication out in our community ... I'm proud to endorse Paul Hudson for Congress. His experience in the legal sector and his fiscally conservative values are deeply needed to stop DC politicians' reckless spending of our tax dollars and soft on crime policies that have hurt our communities back home." - Senator Roger Victory
"... In my view, Congress' out of control spending is placing our country on the wrong path. Grand Rapids Township has to balance its budget every year. Unless we elect more common-sense, fiscally conservative representatives like Paul, Washington will never get its budget in balance. At this critical time, Paul Hudson is the right guy to send as our representative for West Michigan." - Grand Rapids Township Supervisor Mike DeVries

# Someone Who Will Actually Represent the People
"Our district has a history of thoughtful representatives with an independent streak. Our current representative says she fits this mold, then votes in lockstep with her party. We need to return to someone who actually will represent the people and perspectives of our district -- Paul Hudson!" - Kent County Commissioner Matt Kallman

# A Proven Leader ... Will Make a Difference
"Paul Hudson is a proven leader with the skill set and demeanor necessary to represent Kent County, and that's why I'm proud to endorse him for Congress. Paul understands that Washington needs to rein in its unchecked spending and debt .... Paul will make West Michigan's concerns heard in the corridors of Congress and he will make a difference." - Kent County Commissioner Ben Greene
# Concerned ... and Committed
"Unlike most of the people serving in Congress who seem totally indifferent to the out-of-control federal budget, Paul Hudson is genuinely concerned about putting a stop to annual trillion-dollar deficits that are unsustainable and wrecking our children's future. Congress primary job is to manage the federal budget and Paul is committed to getting the job done right." - Kent County Treasurer Pete MacGregor
# Advocate for Small Business
"I believe Paul will be a very effective advocate for West Michigan small business because he knows that the success of free enterprise is the key to growth and economic prosperity for all our citizens. I am confident he'll fight for business owners because he understands their immense impact across our communities." - Small Business Owner and Former State Rep. Tommy Brann

subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osfuijQWNr)

---
| | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63188291:sfuijQWNr:m:1:2532013465:4314EEE50267C798886F196BA96CBB80:r)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?**
This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63188291:sfuijQWNr:m:1:2532013465:4314EEE50267C798886F196BA96CBB80:r)** , from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.
This eBook consists of two papers--one from each scholar--written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being.
I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders.
**[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63188291:sfuijQWNr:m:1:2532013465:4314EEE50267C798886F196BA96CBB80:r)**
Thanks, Greg
Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University

What if I told you that the Supreme Court has _repeatedly_ ruled that law enforcement has no legal duty or obligation to protect the American people from harm or even death? _Let 's Address This._
In 1989 SCOTUS ruled in _Deshaney v. Winnebago County Department of Social Services_ , that 4-year-old Joshua DeShaney could not sue child welfare officials for failing to intervene to protect him from a beating so severe he suffered brain injury that left him institutionalized. Why? The Supreme Court [concluded](https://substack.com/redirect/f6617fa3-22a1-4144-8567-0073f7c23f42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Nothing in the language of the due process clause itself requires the state to protect the life, liberty and property of its citizens against invasion by private actors.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..R-AGDrCu4RQ1d_-zeC8U2rs0VqH_7BNK1wsTvg7us4I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144562771)
Some 16 years later in 2005 the Supreme Court reaffirmed in _Castle Rock v. Gonzales_ that police have "no legal duty to protect the public." In that case case, a woman filed a restraining order against her estranged husband to protect herself and her three daughters. Her estranged husband violated the restraining order and kidnapped her daughters. Gonzales went to law enforcement to ask them enforce the restraining order and bring her daughters back. Police refused. In the meantime, her estranged husband killed all three of her daughters and was himself killed when he later attacked the police department. Gonzales sued, alleging her daughters were killed because police failed to enforce the restraining order as they were required to do. Again, the Supreme Court ruled, quite cruelly:
> [Gonzales] has no constitutionally-protected property interest in the enforcement of the restraining order, and therefore could not claim that the police had violated her right to due process.
A Federal judge reaffirmed this ruling in 2018 when Parkland students sued the police officer who ran away from the shooting, holding that the officer had no duty to protect the Parkland students suffering a deadly mass shooting. To be clear, this was the police officer hired specifically to protect students from harm and mass shootings.
In short, the U.S. Supreme Court argues, perhaps better than any entity in existence, that public safety does not increase with more police funding, in part because police have no obligation to protect the public from harm and death. And while likely unintended in their cruel decision making, the Supreme Court's draconian rulings force us to recognize that we must stop seeing public safety as a Police matter--and instead see it from the lens of societal needs. A lens that accounts for (but is not limited to) things like addressing poverty, addiction, mental health access, suicide prevention, homelessness, and other similar social services--all things police officers are _not_ trained to do but asked to do anyway.
As I've said before, law enforcement _responds_ to crime, but a living wage, food and water security, accessible healthcare, affordable housing, addiction treatment, and public education _prevent_ crime. So if we want safer communities, then it is critical we invest in building up people, not meting out punishments.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..R-AGDrCu4RQ1d_-zeC8U2rs0VqH_7BNK1wsTvg7us4I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144562771)
And the data backs this up. A recent study of more than 4.3 million 911 calls showed "only 6.4% of 911 calls were for violent matters." As TIME [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/00020583-ddfb-4569-95a4-89b10007d4d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> But according to this study, mental health incidents only made up 1.3% of all the calls examined, and only 4% of those calls resulted in an officer being dispatched (though the survey did not track the actions of 911 dispatchers specifically). The largest percent of the calls were traffic-related at 16.8%. followed by "disorder" at 16.2% and "suspicion" calls--from individuals worried that a crime might happen or has happened--at 12.8%. Calls for violent incidents specifically were at 6.4%.
Imagine, only 6.4% were for violent incidents, meaning the other 94% were for non-violent matters! We must therefore ask ourselves: _If public health and safety is our top priority --do our current budgets reflect this reality?_ I would argue emphatically, no.
Take Uvalde, for example, the site of one of the worst atrocities ever committed in modern American history. Robb Elementary had 576 students--and 84% were economically disadvantaged. We painfully recall how 19 students were murdered, 17 more suffered bullet wounds, and 538 are emotionally scarred the rest of their lives. Yet, the school had just one counselor to tend to the mental and social health needs of those children. _One_. Meanwhile, Uvalde Police consumed 40% of the town budget--and they still had no obligation to protect students from being murdered. This is, in short, a failed system.
Then, people cite mental health issues as a reason for violence--but the facts show that people with mental health issues are not some major or even minor source of community violence, and are most likely to suffer violence as a result of their mental illness, than perpetuate violence. As the Frontiers in Psychiatry Journal [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/b5ba4e5b-c038-467f-801f-7140f306a98f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> People with a mental health disorder have a significantly higher risk of becoming victims of violence compared to the general population. Previous research has focused largely on violent crimes such as physical assault, aggravated acquisitive crimes, violent threats, and sexual offenses in this population. Fewer studies have observed rates of victimization of non-violent crimes such as theft, robberies, or threats in this population for which the elevated risk compared to the general population persists.
And once again, the data backs this up, for example, as it relates to police violence. From 2015 to 2021 [police killed more than 1400 people with mental illness](https://substack.com/redirect/f18d6728-15a6-4a47-9aa0-3ce6046acd7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is one consequences of asking law enforcement to address matters they have zero training or ability to address. What sense does it make to send an armed agent of the state to address someone suffering a healthcare crisis?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..R-AGDrCu4RQ1d_-zeC8U2rs0VqH_7BNK1wsTvg7us4I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144562771)
But, despite these dire circumstances, proven models exist to turn the tide. I've [written previously](https://substack.com/redirect/457b1c6b-0aa8-462a-b3b0-44d68f0fd2aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the need to end qualified immunity and pass the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act--but beyond that--we must also allocate meaningful resources to effectively meet societal needs. And we have proven models that demonstrate what this could, or maybe should, look like.
For example, in 2020 Denver deployed a pilot non-lethal mental health team to respond to mental health 911 calls and other non-violent 911 calls, all as a means to meet societal needs better than responding with an armed and untrained law enforcement officer. As [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/b1a37db0-53e4-4cb6-b97c-9a154e20a77c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Previously, Denver 911 operators only directed calls to police or fire department first responders. But the Support Team Assistance Response (STAR) pilot program created a third track for directing emergency calls to a two-person team: a medic and a clinician, staffed in a van from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays.
After an astounding 748 deployments, the STAR pilot program reported zero violent incidents, zero needs to call the police, and zero need to arrest anyone in need. This meant that civilians received the critical 911 support they needed through trained professionals, that law enforcement was more available for the 6.4% violent 911 calls, and that Denver's budget better reflected the societal need to advance public safety. A true win-win for all parties involved.
Meanwhile, in our current policing strategy, police kill more than 1100 civilians a year (leading the developed world). The USA likewise leads the world in incarceration rates, we suffer the highest recidivism rates at nearly 70%, and more than 60% of people in jail need mental health treatment. This is not public safety. But cities like Denver prove a community model works.
Therefore, we must expand upon Denver's model. Because in our current reality--where police have no duty to protect dozens of murdered school children from terrorism in Parkland or Uvalde, then escape liability due to the absurd doctrine of Qualified Immunity, is not just. The current model of people suffering from social ills like addiction, mental illness, and poverty getting jailed or killed--not treated--is not sustainable and will only lead to more violence.
Finally, and significantly, this model also makes the lives of police officers safer and better. The "Blue Lives Matter" folks should be 100% behind this because a public safety model that ensures police aren't asked to do things they aren't trained to do means the lives of police officers are safer as well.
We cannot rely on the Supreme Court to save us, unfortunately. But fortunately, we know a better and proven public safety model exists and works. One that recognizes true public safety as allocating resources through the lens of societal need, not through the lens of more law enforcement and harsher punishments. We simply need to political will and mass movement of citizens pushing them to ensure it happens.

Friends, The U.S. Senate Republican Primary is just around the corner and it's important that you educate yourself and know the difference between all of the candidates who have successfully collected their signatures and will appear on the ballot this coming June. Here's what you should know.
On Tuesday, June 18, 2024, Republicans will vote for and elect the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. This seat is currently held by Democrat Senator Tim Kaine.
Many of you have asked who I am supporting for U.S. Senate.
After carefully listening to all of the candidates and doing my research, I'm supporting Chuck Smith.
In fact, last week I decided to join his team as Senior Advisor for the remaining weeks of the race, because I want to make sure he wins.
Why? Because I believe in Chuck. He has the grit and tenacity to challenge the status quo, not become part of it. He's a marine who I've seen first hand not give up when his back was against the wall.
You see, I've known Chuck Smith for over a 15 years. He had the guts to challenge Congressman Bobby Scott in the old 3rd Congressional District. It was a district that leaned heavily Democrat, but Chuck still answered the call. These Democrats need to be challenged and not given a pass just because they live in a district that leans Democrat.
When I was standing against unconstitutional Covid mandates, the big 2021 gun grab, the socialistic monument grab, the 2020 stealing of a presidential election and standing with J6ers who are being held as political enemies, there was only one of these candidates who stood with me in the fight.
That person was Chuck Smith.
Chuck Smith was one of the only politicians in the trenches and in the streets of Richmond standing with me to defend your Constitutional rights
Chuck is not a newcomer to Virginia politics. He served as the GOP Chair for the Virginia Beach Republican Party and successfully led Republicans to victory in all local, state and federal levels. Sorry, but where have these newcomers been? Have they been in the trenches with you and I for the past 4 years?
When President Trump ran for President the first time, many Republicans tried to keep some of President Trump's supporters from voting in the Republican Primary. Chuck successfully represented these supporters and won. Thanks to Chuck these Virginians were allowed to vote.
I truly believe all 5 candidates are good people and I'll support whoever the Republican nominee is, but I hope you will join me in casting a vote for Chuck Smith on Tuesday, June 18.
While I hope if elected the others would stand strong, I KNOW if elected Chuck will stand strong and not become apart of the DC Swamp.
Please donate Chuck's campaign by clicking the link below.
Chuck has a history of supporting President Trump, even from the very beginning. We can count him to support President Trump once elected so that we can truly make America Great Again!

VOTE TUESDAY, JUNE 18 | Friends, The U.S. Senate Republican Primary is just around the corner and it's important that you educate yourself and know the difference between all of the candidates who have successfully collected their signatures and will appear on the ballot this coming June. Here's what you should know. On Tuesday, June 18, 2024, Republicans will vote for and elect the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. This seat is currently held by Democrat Senator Tim Kaine. Many of you have asked who I am supporting for U.S. Senate. After carefully listening to all of the candidates and doing my research, I'm supporting Chuck Smith. In fact, last week I decided to join his team as Senior Advisor for the remaining weeks of the race, because I want to make sure he wins. Why? Because I believe in Chuck. He has the grit and tenacity to challenge the status quo, not become part of it. He's a marine who I've seen first hand not give up when his back was against the wall. You see, I've known Chuck Smith for over a 15 years. He had the guts to challenge Congressman Bobby Scott in the old 3rd Congressional District. It was a district that leaned heavily Democrat, but Chuck still answered the call. These Democrats need to be challenged and not given a pass just because they live in a district that leans Democrat. When I was standing against unconstitutional Covid mandates, the big 2021 gun grab, the socialistic monument grab, the 2020 stealing of a presidential election and standing with J6ers who are being held as political enemies, there was only one of these candidates who stood with me in the fight. That person was Chuck Smith. Chuck Smith was one of the only politicians in the trenches and in the streets of Richmond standing with me to defend your Constitutional rights Chuck is not a newcomer to Virginia politics. He served as the GOP Chair for the Virginia Beach Republican Party and successfully led Republicans to victory in all local, state and federal levels. Sorry, but where have these newcomers been? Have they been in the trenches with you and I for the past 4 years? When President Trump ran for President the first time, many Republicans tried to keep some of President Trump's supporters from voting in the Republican Primary. Chuck successfully represented these supporters and won. Thanks to Chuck these Virginians were allowed to vote. I truly believe all 5 candidates are good people and I'll support whoever the Republican nominee is, but I hope you will join me in casting a vote for Chuck Smith on Tuesday, June 18. While I hope if elected the others would stand strong, I KNOW if elected Chuck will stand strong and not become apart of the DC Swamp. Please donate Chuck's campaign by clicking the link below.
