Today is the first day of the annual NRA convention
#

Friends -
Today is the first day of the annual NRA convention, which is taking place this year in Dallas.
Tomorrow, Donald Trump will take the stage as their keynote speaker.
Donald Trump has made it clear time and time again that he cares far more about cozying up to the NRA than he does about our safety.
This is what we’re up against—a gun lobby and the politicians they pay for that are so committed to the profits of gun manufacturers that the impact on our communities is simply the cost of doing business.
Under Donald Trump’s leadership, gun homicides spiked by a whopping 34 percent. He’s bragged about how he “did nothing” about guns during his presidency.
**It’s despicable.**
As the NRA begins its convention, we need you with us to fight back. The only way we can stand up to the gun lobby and its dark influence on our politicians is through the support of people like you.

subject: FWD What is Joe Biden Trying to Hide Now?
body:
This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out. Joe Biden and his administration are stonewalling Judicial Watch over the release of critical public documents directly related to the president's possible criminal liability for the unauthorized removal, retention and disclosure of classified documents after he left office as vice-president in 2017.

| Dear Fellow American,

No one fights harder for the American people's "right to know" than Judicial Watch.

That's why I want to be sure you have a chance to read this email that I sent you recently.

We will go the distance, through the legal system and the courts, to make sure Joe Biden and his Justice Department do NOT succeed in hiding these tapes from the American people.

And [we will be especially grateful to you for your support today to help us fund this battle](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2), and all our other work!

Thank you,

Tom Fitton
President

* * *

**From:** Tom Fitton
**Date:** Friday, May 10, 2024 at 9:14 AM
**Subject:** What is Joe Biden Trying to Hide Now?
**To:** dpwillis67@gmail.com
| |

| Dear Fellow American,

This is a very serious and urgent matter, so please hear me out.
Joe Biden and his administration are stonewalling **Judicial Watch** over the release of critical public documents directly related to the president's possible criminal liability for the unauthorized removal, retention and disclosure of classified documents after he left office as vice-president in 2017.
We are fighting back with every legal tool we have...but [**we need your help!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

You may recall, Special Counsel Robert Hur taped recordings of Biden's interviews with prosecutors earlier this year...and later, in his official report, Hur famously called Biden a "well-meaning, elderly man with a poor memory" and declined to charge the president with a "serious felony."

**_Judicial Watch_** _believes the American people have a right to hear these tapes_ , and make up their own minds about Joe Biden's testimony and his credibility....because "no one is above the law," including the President of the United States.

And at **Judicial Watch,** we also believe in _one standard of justice applied to all_!

That's why we sued the Justice Department back in March, after they failed to respond to our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request for those audio records.

**[And that's why I am asking you to give us your support today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Just last week the Justice Department told us that they would not release the two audio tapes because they would constitute a "clearly unwarranted invasion of personal privacy."

I believe that the public's right to know about Joe Biden's actions related to the documents he removed the from the White House outweighs his privacy in this case, _and we will go the legal distance to force the release of records from the Special Counsel's investigation!_

Of course, that costs money.

It's easy to complain about Joe Biden's efforts to hide documents and audio recordings from the American people that "we the people" have a right to see and hear...

_But where others complain,**Judicial Watch** acts_!

[I deeply hope you will help us with a contribution now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2), so that we can keep the legal pressure on, in this lawsuit and in all our lawsuits fighting against public corruption and for transparency in government.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68339&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Thank you in advance for giving us your support today!

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

There have been a lot of updates in our fight for OH-01, and we wanted to make sure our top supporters – like you! – were up to speed.

**FIRST: A top GOP super PAC** – with direct ties to Speaker of the House Mike Johnson – **endorsed Greg’s opponent.**

**THEN: Donald Trump came to Cincinnati to host a MASSIVE fundraiser** – and we know that some of that money will be spent right here in OH-01.

**NOW: We’re halfway through May, but we aren’t halfway toward our May fundraising goal.**

As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.
But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.
As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.
On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.
The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to extreme, big-money donors.
I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources immediately to start putting his feet to the fire.

body:
In my life, I’ve taken two oaths to uphold and defend the U.S. Constitution. | | | Fellow Patriot, In my life, I’ve taken two oaths to uphold and defend the U.S. Constitution.

**The first was when I joined the U.S. Army.**

I led men into war as an Apache Helicopter Pilot and fought to defend our freedom from despots and tyrants.

It wasn’t easy, but it taught me the sacrifice that comes with liberty and left me with an undying respect for the bravery of my fellow military service men and women.

**More recently, I took my second oath when I was sworn into the United States Congress.**

In Washington, I fight for our liberty and freedom with the same intensity on the House floor as I did on the battlefield.

_Neither path has been an easy one_. Whether it’s dodging enemy fire on the battlefield or facing the hate of the radical Left at home, there is always a threat.

**But the fight for freedom is worth any price**.****

name: David
subject: The People's Congress: Congress threatens accountability and compromises our safety during National Police week
body:
National Police Week was recognized, and in a disappointing move, Congress pushed forward with a slew of bills that threaten to dial back... | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/davidkimforca/the-peoples-congress-congress-threatens-accountability-and-compromises-our-safety-during-national-police-week?e=fee98d637f)
---
| | |
---
| | | | **Dear Friends,** **This week in The People’s Congress, National Police Week was recognized, and in a disappointing move, Congress pushed forward with a slew of bills that threaten to dial back accountability and compromise the safety of our communities.

During this pivotal week, Congress considered legislation that requires fierce progressive advocacy, which sadly was in short supply. From urgently reimagining our approach to law enforcement to critically evaluating our role on the international stage, each bill presented this week is a battleground where our core values of justice, fairness, and peace are at stake. Let’s dive into the legislative actions of this week and prepare for the challenges that lie ahead.**
---
| _**Reflecting on This Week's Key Legislation:**_
---
| **Israel Security Assistance Support Act (H.R. 8396):**

Amidst the ongoing conflict in Gaza, this legislation seeks to guarantee continuous military aid to Israel, despite recent findings that the weaponry we are providing has been used in violation of international law. I stand in complete opposition to the passage of this bill, which the House voted on this Thursday **(224 YEAS, 187 NAYS)**

While I was pleased to see President Biden's decision to withhold a munitions shipment to Israel, I believe we must take even bolder steps to promote a lasting peace. It is crucial that we suspend all military aid to Israel as long as the aggressive onslaught against Palestinians continues. Our foreign policy should embody our deepest commitment to human rights and peace, urging all parties towards diplomatic resolutions that ensure long-term stability and safety for all involved. That is why I have continued to advocate for a permanent ceasefire and push for negotiations that respect the dignity and rights of every individual affected by this conflict.
---
|
---
| **Detain and Deport Illegal Aliens Who Assault Cops Act (H.R. 7343):**

In a move I am very disappointed to see, Congress passed this bill **(265 YEAS, 148 NAYS)** , which requires anyone who is accused of assaulting a police officer to be detained if they are not a U.S. citizen. This measure does not keep police officers safer and it does not keep our communities safer either. Instead it could disproportionately impact immigrant communities, risking human rights abuses and undermining due process.

Last weekend I visited the U.S. Mexico border, where I witnessed firsthand the struggles faced by immigrants seeking safety and better opportunities. Many flee violence and persecution, hoping to build a safer future for their families, just as many of our immigrant ancestors and relatives did. Our immigration policies must reflect these realities and focus on comprehensive reform that ensures public safety through fair, transparent practices while respecting human dignity. We must reject fear-based policies and work towards a system that upholds justice and compassion for all individuals. Instead, this bill looks for another reason to demonize immigrants while looking to score cheap political points.
---
|
---
| **Police Our Border Act (H.R. 8146):**

The divisive language used in the "Police Our Border Act", which passed the House on Thursday **(254 YEAS,157 NAYS)** , frames immigration as a security crisis, overshadowing the critical need for humane and comprehensive immigration reform. When we create legislation aimed at protecting the safety of border officers, it is equally important to address immigration in a manner that respects human rights and provides a fair process for asylum seekers.

You might be surprised to know that many Congresspeople have never visited our border, and have never met a family applying for asylum, or seen the detention centers in which immigrants are kept. It is impossible to create legislation that fairly and accurately addresses immigration without firsthand knowledge. I went to the border to deepen my understanding of the complexities of our immigration system. And what I saw reinforced my belief that we must implement humane immigration practices. Our policies should prioritize integrating technology and improving the efficiency of asylum processing to address security concerns without resorting to fear-based narratives.
---
|
---
| **LEOSA Reform Act of 2024 (H.R. 354):**

Passing the House on Thursday **(221 YEAS, 185 NAYS)** , the LEOSA Reform Act seeks to broaden the environments in which law enforcement officers can carry concealed weapons, including schools and national parks.

The [National Education Association](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=4c764659c7&e=fee98d637f) sums up the bill best in their letter to Congress, by stating, _“The LEOSA Reform Act will not make us safer. The legislation will in fact bring more guns to the places we gather, by expanding the authority for active and retired law enforcement officers to carry concealed firearms across state lines. H.R. 354 allows for the carrying of concealed firearms in almost all places open to the public.”_

This approach not only disregards the principles of gun-free zones, but also raises serious concerns about the safety and well-being of the public in traditionally safe spaces. As a proponent of gun control and community safety, I strongly advocate for policies that emphasize de-escalation, mental health training, and community engagement. Enhanced training and partnerships, not more guns, are the keys to safer communities.
---
|
---
| **Youth Justice in D.C. (H.R. 7530):**

The DC CRIMES Act, which proposes to redefine 'youth' in criminal sentencing and restricts lighter sentencing options, passed the House on Wednesday **(225 YEAS, 184 NAYS)**. This bill will severely impact young people's futures, and blatantly disregards the evidence-based lessons we have learned from the era of mass incarceration. As a progressive voice, I advocate for a justice system that prioritizes rehabilitation over punishment, particularly for youth. Our focus should be on restorative justice practices that provide young individuals with opportunities for investment and growth, rather than trapping them in a cycle of incarceration.

---
|
---
| **Condemnations and Safety Resolutions (H.Res. 1213 & H.Res. 1210):**

These resolutions, which link policy changes like “defunding the police” to increased violence against law enforcement, are yet more examples of Congress’s failure to provide actual leadership, relying instead on empty rhetoric that does nothing to address the needs of communities or law enforcement. There are serious issues facing our communities, yet Congressional leaders want to use grandstanding and bluster rather than actually address the issues that affect the lives of the voters. I’m not running for Congress to talk a good game; I’m running for Congress to respond to the needs of our district. Sloganeering is not going to make communities safer; instead we should invest in community-led safety initiatives that build trust and cooperation between law enforcement and the communities they serve. Effective public safety requires comprehensive community engagement and resources that support both preventive measures and crisis response.

---
|
---
| | _**Congressional Agenda Look Ahead:**_
* **_Farm Bill Discussions:_ **As we approach the markup of the Farm Bill, there are concerns about significant cuts to the SNAP program (also known as food stamps or EBT) and the removal of climate guardrails. It’s vital that we advocate for a bill that supports our agricultural communities sustainably and equitably.

* _**Budget and Appropriations:**_ As FY24 funding concludes, our focus shifts to the FY25 budget. Expect debates over allocations that will significantly impact our social services and economic stability.

---
|
---
| _**Your Voice Matters:**_

As these discussions unfold, your engagement is crucial. Whether it’s calling your Congressmember and/or Senators about troubling bills, or advocating for progressive reforms in community policing and immigration, your voice can drive change.

Visit [davidkimforca.com/volunteer/ ](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=37b20fb169&e=fee98d637f)to find out how you can get involved.

Want to call your representative? [CLICK HERE](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=cc6b5b9b8c&e=fee98d637f) to find their contact information!

Thank you for your dedication to our cause. Together, we can uplift our community—and our country—towards a more just and compassionate future.

Warm regards,

David Kim
Candidate for Congress, CA-34

name: Carla Sands
subject: Update From Carla Sands!
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1133197d23d1/update-from-carla-sands?e=b254a3b575)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend,

Happy Spring! As the summer approaches we find ourselves in an election year with the GOP convention fast-approaching.

I am delighted to share that AFPI (America First Policy Institute) continues to grow as we plan for the next conservative administration. We recently brought onboard outstanding lawyers focused on election integrity and fighting against the weaponization of government. At AFPI we have dozens of former Republican cabinet officials, U.S. Ambassadors, and patriots who have served at the senior level in previous conservative administrations.

Recently AFPI has taken the top two floors at the Willard Hotel for our new headquarters. Our founder and CEO Brooke Rollins says that she is building a battle tank for the next 100 years. In a historic first since Richard Nixon, we are working with dozens of other conservative organizations throughout the nation so that we don’t duplicate our efforts during this election season.

In addition, we are actively working on a transition plan so that when President Donald Trump is re-elected in November, we will be better prepared to implement America First policies on day one. You can learn more about AFPI **[here](https://carlasands.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=99d251bf9c4705c4eb727273b&id=160b087926&e=b254a3b575).**

I believe we need to re-elect President Donald J. Trump in order to return our great country back to the land of opportunity, bring down inflation, and reestablish peace around the world. We know that from 2017 until he left office, inflation was below 2% and we were involved in no new foreign wars. President Trump led like Ronald Reagan, with peace through strength.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Dear Friend, Happy Spring! As the summer approaches we find ourselves in an election year with the GOP convention fast-approaching. I am delighted to share that AFPI (America First Policy Institute) continues to grow as we plan for the next conservative administration. We recently brought onboard outstanding lawyers focused on election integrity and fighting against the weaponization of government. At AFPI we have dozens of former Republican cabinet officials, U.S. Ambassadors, and patriots who have served at the senior level in previous conservative administrations. Recently AFPI has taken the top two floors at the Willard Hotel for our new headquarters. Our founder and CEO Brooke Rollins says that she is building a battle tank for the next 100 years. In a historic first since Richard Nixon, we are working with dozens of other conservative organizations throughout the nation so that we don’t duplicate our efforts during this election season. In addition, we are actively working on a transition plan so that when President Donald Trump is re-elected in November, we will be better prepared to implement America First policies on day one. You can learn more about AFPI . I believe we need to re-elect President Donald J. Trump in order to return our great country back to the land of opportunity, bring down inflation, and reestablish peace around the world. We know that from 2017 until he left office, inflation was below 2% and we were involved in no new foreign wars. President Trump led like Ronald Reagan, with peace through strength. During the Trump presidency the Abraham Accords were established, ISIS was defeated, neither Putin nor Xi invaded their neighbors, and even North Korea was more peaceful toward us. This was a direct result of Trump’s strong leadership and historic diplomacy. President Trump’s policies secured our southern border. As a result of his historic trade negotiations (such as USMCA) and his Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, we had the best employment in 50 years for women and minorities, and the Forgotten Men and Women saw the biggest gains. While on the campaign trail, President Trump has vowed to keep males out of female’s sports, which is really important to me as the mom of a daughter. He has also stated publicly that he will end DEI in our schools and in our military – where our children are failing to learn, and our military recruitment is down, with military services missing recruiting goals by 41,000 in the 2023 fiscal year. Unsurprisingly, our active-duty force is the smallest it has been since 1940. President Trump will end this DEI war on our readiness and education. In the 2022 Pennsylvania Senate race, on election day, Democrat candidate John Fetterman had already banked about 1 million ballots during early the voting season. Republican candidate Mehmet Oz had banked about 250,000. Four to one Democrat to Republican. Democrats used every day of the 50 days of early voting to register voters, helped them with their mail-in ballots, and helped them vote early in person; every day was used. Republicans mostly voted on election day. We all know that Mehmet Oz came up short because Republicans did not vote early. In 2023 and 2024 it has been the same story. Many races and special elections were lost because Democrats voted early, and Republicans didn’t. In the special election in New York to replace Representative George Santos, Democrats voted early all 9 days of New York early voting. Republicans waited until election day, and there was a snowstorm. The Democrat candidate won. Most states have early voting. Please see the handy chart below to help you vote early in your state. In Florida, Republicans have embraced early voting and Republicans are winning elections. Florida has gone from being a swing state to a solid red state. America First Policy Institute has a C4 arm called . You can choose to join our telegram channel and learn how to get people registered to vote and to the polls. If you are a churchgoer or gun owner, I hope you will help register people to vote in this critical election. Please see the table below for early voting information in every state. Vote on the first legal day either in-person or by mail if your state allows it. You can also call your county board election office for instructions. I urge you to review your county's and state's guidlines for mail-in voting and sign up today! In a bit of personal news, my dear daughter graduated with her degree in Psychology and Business, and my precious parents are chugging along in Pennsylvania. A few weeks ago, I was part of AMAC’s and AFW’s (America First Works) “Bootcamp for Boomers” in Bucks County Pennsylvania. Bucks County is one of the key 19 counties Donald Trump needs to win in order to be re-elected President. | | I recently joined the Christ Plant Show for a few episodes. | | I joined Steve Bannon on War Room. | | I joined the Steak for Breakfast Podcast, Episode 355 - March 22, 2024. | | I have been busy pushing back against the Democrats’ war on American energy. America First policies offer an alternative of abundant and affordable American energy. Here are a few examples of my recent Op-Eds addressing this important issue. "" "" "" "" In closing, even if it’s not your favorite thing, I hope you will commit to voting early this year! Thank you for all that you are doing to save our country and for keeping the American Dream alive. body:

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6452%2E5257348%2EMbgHtx)
Derek,
Louis DeJoy is destroying the United States Postal Service.
[**We have a rare opportunity to make real changes at USPS — and none is more urgent than getting rid of this Trump lackey. If enough of us speak up, we can create the momentum to replace him.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240517-dejoy-petition.l90uDj&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240517_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=6452%2E5257348%2EMbgHtx)
[STOP LOUIS DEJOY](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240517-dejoy-petition.l90uDj&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240517_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=6452%2E5257348%2EMbgHtx)
---
I’ve long called for President Biden to submit his nominees for the USPS Board of Governors to the Senate so they can confirm members to fill the two vacant seats and finally vote to remove Louis DeJoy.
As the finance chair of the Republican National Committee, DeJoy raised and contributed millions to GOP candidates.
He was investigated by the FBI for an alleged straw donor scheme with his employees where he would award bonuses as kickbacks for political contributions.
His family is heavily invested in a direct competitor of the USPS — and one of his first acts as Postmaster General was to award that private company with a $120 million contract.
He slowed down the mail during the 2020 election at the height of the pandemic and has repeatedly raised prices while providing worse service.
He even attempted to purchase 90% gasoline-powered vehicles for the Postal Service fleet instead of moving to a greener fleet until we passed legislation and he finally gave in.
[**Add your name to call for President Biden to send his nominees for the USPS Board of Governors who can vote to replace him to the Senate. We have to remove DeJoy before the election gets underway.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240517-dejoy-petition.l90uDj&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240517_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=6452%2E5257348%2EMbgHtx)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240517-dejoy-petition.l90uDj&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240517_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=6452%2E5257348%2EMbgHtx)
---
There is no excuse for allowing this hyperpartisan, potentially corrupt Postmaster General to lead the Postal Service during a presidential election in which the nominee of his party, Donald Trump, who gave him the job and incited a violent insurrection after he lost, is running against the incumbent president. A conflict of interest hardly begins to describe it.
So please, take a moment today to join me and raise your voice. This is important.
Thanks,
Adam

| MANAKIN SABOT, VA \-- 100% Pro-Trump 5th Congressional District candidate, former Navy SEAL, Virginia Senator, and business owner John McGuire today announced that he has been endorsed by Hanover Sheriff Stuart Cook (Retired) for the Republican Congressional Primary June 18.
---
| Hanover Sheriff Stuart Cook (Retired) Endorses John McGuire
---
| | |
---|---
|
"I am proud to endorse Senator John McGuire for Congress. As a Navy SEAL he is relentless in all he does. I don't normally get involved in nominating contests, but there is too much at stake in our country and our Commonwealth. John is a true partner in law enforcement with a strong track record of supporting law enforcement in the General Assembly. Please join me in supporting Senator John McGuire to be our next Congressman in the Republican Primary on June 18th!"

-Hanover Sheriff Stuart Cook (Retired)

Paid for and Authorized by McGuire for Virginia
| McGuire said: "I'm honored to have the support and endorsement of fellow Trump supporter and very respected Hanover Sheriff Stuart Cook (Retired), especially during police appreciation week. Sheriff Cook spent 45 years in law enforcement and was Hanover's Sheriff for 20 years. Without our men and women in law enforcement we would not have a country. Thank you for keeping us safe! With your support, I will continue my fight in Congress. We must win in June and give President Trump a Congress that 100% supports his America First Agenda."

As Police Week closes, I'm proud to announce Sheriff Greg Zyburt's endorsement of my campaign for US Congress. Your contribution today supports our collective efforts. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
Sheriff Zyburt's endorsement signifies his confidence in our ability to uphold the values of justice, compassion, and reform.
In and outside the county, voters know Greg Zyburt for his proactive approach to law enforcement. As a law enforcement leader, he's done incredible things for the entire State of Michigan, and it's a true honor to have him in our corner.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
As an addiction specialist, I commend Sheriff Zyburt's vision for safer communities and aim to address the root causes of crime through comprehensive reform.
We share the goals of treatment and community empowerment, and our mission aligns well with Sheriff Zyburt's efforts to reduce recidivism and promote rehabilitation.
Furthermore, the day Sheriff Zyburt discussed his endorsement, he had just given a speech emphasizing, "No one hates a bad cop more than a good cop hates a bad cop."
Sheriff Zyburt is an excellent leader and someone I am proud to be involved in my campaign. As Police Week continues, I'd like to thank all police officers across nation who uphold the dignity and integrity of serving and protecting.
Onward,
Bob

In 2016, Trump won Wisconsin by less than a percentage point. That year,

presidency.

body:
you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=f640aa42da7f4012b9ddd94e47594129&_e=3UKfzoOQHGDPlJMfNAVXf2m-r6wf481mbhDOOcFYAeQlQc66lj0s4ULfd7NmL10QEGge8zQ6K1vHe4MTVTAuHVSgZUce5OLEs4NACCemNY17Y7f7eVyPknzQlsS5jqsInZARll7vRuM84Pwd4hUa2pk2KBKW09X8qLnY9f9W8BPRjLqUfIAC5xWjb_Ym8I8mz-MMgSP2pJW51Z8EHlFY6iTA1cU8L6l0bPbYXbhQIEfUuLTNHy10vA4WGur8ftgl3_fOMpN35CDzL7F-seQ7NUwXQO0-EAe3oouvfWE4tZwRv3Ndotx_ugZuIzpRL7dyMeytSkEIYOW9olCpqUp-ZrGijPb9Kv9g9stnDpDgZMHjx6c6Dbhg_Lh4Ywadmd2H699_a1Yvc2QIRI4aZsG68bZuzZvA8JTUy6l-1y5dBdw%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=f640aa42da7f4012b9ddd94e47594129&_e=3UKfzoOQHGDPlJMfNAVXf2m-r6wf481mbhDOOcFYAeQlQc66lj0s4ULfd7NmL10QEGge8zQ6K1vHe4MTVTAuHVSgZUce5OLEs4NACCemNY17Y7f7eVyPknzQlsS5jqsInZARll7vRuM84Pwd4hUa2pk2KBKW09X8qLnY9f9W8BPRjLqUfIAC5xWjb_Ym8I8mz-MMgSP2pJW51Z8EHlFY6iTA1cU8L6l0bPbYXbhQIEfUuLTNHy10vA4WGur8ftglBNHhMvxEUA3Lq0JVZ9-10t6rmYclBekdQN9Q6RJcynQNhS0vSm4cPmlgeDkp6jhkhjCXkknw-g1rnBDsn_1D6N5BCVRh7nnmpd1RdmG5DpdhLIhA8y23TbfROWlXuz4MmkHaCr_vOgvqm8skJjY8Kxj9OQ8ptxh1qPaEU1cBX7k%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=f640aa42da7f4012b9ddd94e47594129&_e=3UKfzoOQHGDPlJMfNAVXf2m-r6wf481mbhDOOcFYAeQlQc66lj0s4ULfd7NmL10QEGge8zQ6K1vHe4MTVTAuHVSgZUce5OLEs4NACCemNY17Y7f7eVyPknzQlsS5jqsInZARll7vRuM84Pwd4hUa2pk2KBKW09X8qLnY9f9W8BPRjLqUfIAC5xWjb_Ym8I8mz-MMgSP2pJW51Z8EHlFY6iTA1cU8L6l0bPbYXbhQIEfUuLTNHy10vA4WGur8ftglEMbudbl-ZaxTmbEvdoDmXxXG4-Xy9H93sjGCXjmwBvyIqK4eEFUBll7JYhtAZc0L_WWS81OnzyuwbVkXqd5Koxgu98MtbFlxrxvHng_Dnn8hVVp1GxrjjNM3f47ZXjIBfknEhYQ92QpBpiN7r22ptkqva6l5QK_5vD9p5qBHuig%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

name: Col. Mike Waltz
subject: Blah blah blah...

| | | **_Blah, blah, blah..._** **Sometimes, it seems like that’s all you hear on Capitol Hill.** _There’s a lot of talk, but no one is willing to do the hard thing and take action._ **That’s not my style.**

My name is Mike Waltz. I’m a Green Beret veteran, a retired Colonel, and an unapologetic conservative.

When I was out on the battlefield, we didn’t get anything done by talking. We acted and responded to threats as they came in.

_Members of Congress could learn a thing or two from America’s bravest._

Today, I’m asking you to stand with me and take action against the radical Left’s assault on our rights.

**[Will you stand with me to DEFEND our American values?](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=db2c746a42c84eb1be8a348904a270ba&_e=luAKoh2Te8BmCFa3lZTuEEEHK-Fphhn3YMvokTuVY8xwopOa0qemV0PpMNfg_F88Sql8SGA5v7wYvM6_Davy2UvZKWjYe6oqEnKlznP6M5pMf-YI5PgYkXhD9tz7dam5220GA0VkhcfsWhQN9RiQdYPicagnccB3TVITcyM1wnNUy2vBcxh54rKdqHCtUIbYo3NdHa17XKhfwyfRSi5hZJLGU0ErHNw81kayzMJmRZJH6FgompKHFTQLC2EYzpQi8YHqvuEKL-IM5N7BOVsWrA0YQQ5EnFOmJPPDT9SVpkdmBVca0ktcqDctqR3TLlXYyVsKGeLOgEV8u-XWwREt7Vlxvws_PFtDTIalqgxfY40%3D)**

People in the corners of the world I’ve fought in would do anything to have the rights and freedoms we have here.

I didn’t back down when terrorists in Afghanistan were threatening our way of life, and I won’t back down when suited-up socialists do the same.

I know you won’t either.

body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Raise your hand if you’ve ever been personally victimized by hidden fees 🙋♀️
Last week, the U.S. Senate held a hearing about “junk fees” [https://www.banking.senate.gov/hearings/fees-and-consumer-protection-issues] and how to crack down on them.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/Screenshot%202024-05-10%20at%2011.08.33%E2%80%AFAM.png]
U.S. Senator Sherrod Brown , Chairman of the of the Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs opened the hearing with remarks about the problem “junk fees” are creating in America:
“These hidden add-ons, surcharges, and fees—are all “junk fees”. They’re extra costs that inflate the price you pay, but add no value. They are often hidden and only disclosed when it is time to pay. Consumers know what they can afford. That’s why we all shop based on price. But when the real price is hidden through undisclosed junk fees, how are consumers supposed to find the lowest price?”
Whether it’s booking a hotel, paying a late fee on your credit card or phone bill, or having “convenience fees” raise your rent. These are prime examples of the dilemma consumers are being put in when it comes to paying for goods and services, to pay or not to pay.
Consumers should not be living in fear of fees lurking in the corners of the checkout screen.
After our hard work on tackling junk fees at the state level, we are so excited to see the federal government continuing the conversation. We are continuing our fight to protect Virginia consumers and ban hidden fees!
Natalie Jones
Digital Manager

Despite vowing in 2020 to never return to Minnesota (we wish), Donald Trump is headed to Saint Paul this evening for a high-dollar GOP fundraiser, and yesterday **attacked Ilhan by name** in an interview with a local right-wing blog.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240517-1-t1&t=2&akid=1148%2E791427%2EzGwCOS)

And you know what? He's right about that much.
**Ilhan _is_ a hater — of Donald Trump.**
Ilhan hates that Donald is a white supremacist and right-wing extremist, one who has spent years dehumanizing and attacking women, people of color, immigrants, the LGBTQ+ community, Muslims, and countless others across the world.
She hates that he and Mitch McConnell stole the Supreme Court, appointing right-wing justices to overturn _Roe v. Wade._
She hates that he has 91 felony charges against him and has spent years undermining and threatening our democracy, yet still is running for public office.
She hates that he and his billionaire friends put the interests of wealthy and powerful corporations before the working class.
She hates that he has a decades-long history of sexually assaulting and abusing women.
**Ilhan hates everything about Donald Trump and what he represents — including the fact that this November, he could become president once again._That's why it's critical that we all stand united in the face of attacks like these._**

Hey there.
I wanted to give you some insight into where things currently stand in our campaign, and some important decisions we have ahead of us.
Now that we’re within 6 months of the election, we're at the point in the race where my team and I will frequently get together early in the morning, armed with coffee, to review our campaign's spending priorities and compare them to our fundraising goals and how close we are to meeting them.
It’s quite a balancing act, and full of strategic choices. And we're getting close to the point where some of the biggest decisions of the campaign will be made: decisions about TV and digital advertising, field operatives, Get Out the Vote operations and more.
And as our team reviews our budget projections for the months ahead, we're thinking about all we'd be able to accomplish if we were able to have a big fundraising day today.
Because the donations made in these months -- before the final push before Election Day -- allow us to make much more strategic spending decisions than money that comes later on: if, when, and how will we hire more staff? When will our mailers hit people's inboxes? How many TV ads can we run -- and when do we air them? Pretty much all of these decisions are made by early summer -- months before the majority of donors check in and finally decide which way to vote.
So we were willing to bank on the fact that if we explained why early investments in our race are so critical, then you, the thoughtful citizen that you are, would chip in to help create more room in our campaign's budget so we have the resources required to win this race.

https://jenaforcolorado.com/ [https://jenaforcolorado.com/]
Friends –
I’m proud that Colorado continues to be a safe haven for women in the western states to receive the medical care they need. We will continue to serve as a leader in women’s reproductive freedom and reject the restrictions that the far right has implemented in other states.
But here’s the truth, Peter, your state should not dictate our rights as women. The government should not be able to control our bodies. Women should be empowered to make our own choices on our health care and reproductive rights.
With access to abortion being under control of the states, women could have to travel hundreds of miles if they need abortion care, pay thousands of dollars to get there, and be left navigating logistics for weeks before being able to get an appointment.
Women should not have to jump through hoops for healthcare.
I will always advocate for women’s reproductive freedom.
– Jena Griswold

Hi there friend,

We wanted to make sure you saw Speaker Johnson's message
regarding President Trump's trial.

Please read this message then take action by signing the
letter.

President Trump needs your support!

---------- Forwarded Message ---------

From: Speaker Mike Johnson

Subject: I was in the courtroom with President Trump.

To: <dpwillis67@gmail.com>

Friend,

I was in the Manhattan Courtroom with President Trump, and I
couldn't believe my eyes!

I already knew this was a sham trial, but when I walked in and
saw how unfairly they were treating President Trump, I was
ashamed.

In Louisiana, I was taught equal justice under the law.
Apparently in Manhattan's court system, it's equal justice if
you're a Democrat.

Make no mistake, President Trump is sitting through this trial
because Election Day is around the corner. I wrote a letter to
President Trump to show our support as he sits through this sham
trial. Will you co-sign this letter with me?

READ & SIGN LETTER TO TRUMP

To: President Donald Trump

From: Speaker Johnson and you,

We stand with you as Radical Left cronies are doing everything
they can to try and destroy you.

While the Left is using the justice system to try and defeat
you, your support from the American people is only growing.

Even as they try to hide the truth from us with the
unconstitutional gag order, we can all see this trial for what it
is!

ELECTION INTERFERENCE

President Trump, you gave up everything to run for President
because you care about the American people.

You stood with us as the Radical Left tried to take away our
freedoms.

And when you saw Joe Biden is destroying our country, you
decided to go through the worst political persecution ever seen
because you care about the American people.

This isn't about justice. This is about politics.

After all you've done for us, we have your back through these
attacks.

We stand with you, President Trump,

-Speaker Johnson and you

SIGN THE OPEN LETTER

President Trump needs to know that he has our support, so I'm
asking you to join me in signing this letter today.

Please take just a moment to add your name to the letter,
friend.

SIGN THE OPEN LETTER

Thank you,

Speaker Johnson

I believe Lanon is the kind of leader Iowa AND America needs right now, but this won’t be an easy race. Right now, we have a real opportunity to flip this district from red to blue — but we need your help to finish this fight and take back the House in 2024. | = Lanon's campaign to flip Iowa's Third Congressional District and take back the House is fueled by grassroots supporters like you, Peter. body:
[1]Powered By People

We are experiencing a major breakdown of law and order in Texas.

If you only listened to Governor Greg Abbott, you’d think that might have
something to do with immigrants. Or President Biden. Or college students.

But when you look at the facts, you see that it has everything to do with
Abbott himself.

From letting energy corporations gouge Texans for billions of dollars in
the middle of a power grid failure that killed hundreds, to weakening gun
laws in the wake of the El Paso massacre and ensuring that Texas would
lead the nation in school shootings, it’s clear that Abbott doesn’t
believe in the rule of law or the safety and security of his fellow
Texans.

And now this.

Yesterday we learned that Abbott succumbed to pressure from the most
extreme elements of his party and pardoned convicted killer Daniel Perry.
Perry was found guilty and sentenced to 25 years in prison for killing
U.S. Air Force veteran Garrett Foster at a 2020 demonstration against
police brutality. Perry is an openly racist thug who boasted in a text
message prior to Foster’s murder that he “might go to Dallas to shoot some
looters.”

And now Perry will walk free.

This is an insult to Foster’s family and an injustice to the people of
Texas. This is not rule of law, it is the lawlessness of a Governor driven
by political considerations, cronyism and corruption.

What can we do about it?

We can do the work that will ultimately replace men like Abbott with
Texans who believe in the law and believe that it should apply equally to
everyone. That means registering new Democratic voters, personally keeping
in touch with them over the coming months and making sure that they turn
out to vote in November.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63499?t=1001&akid=239591%2E444211%2EZqaEoY ]I hope you’ll join us as a volunteer and help us bring about a better
Texas.

Thank you,

Beto

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-april-2024?refcode=20240517 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-april-2024?refcode=20240517]

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=09d11813e8c6499dbe38ceb59ccbbb80&_e=8AFianuBh0T51ibWcGVMFpQcFLd9JVshFiyQmPDfsRhqypQsMinWEjmN-nx7YKhCOZPW9Zfk1NY0KO0_HSL25uzkf-F64WjaWixlWXGB8_nSBoaNGDetcxbuqE4t-O1PVWQyMR9cLqdPvJGoHCAxZ9FUdqEAN5ycs_kaSPQXWaQCoo30ojgfydhbnGGnQ9NNf9TvxTSHA0aK04IYD9KG7soi7OvCwfHtDR554fENQk0-VQ2Sfj58QyTqeJuQpWXogOyym7LTWNX-NlYxCp2pIcdzInmgoKUeRDtDJps2f6yRfkEfqIhkcZgDx6OpdGqOz-CEnHiGf1k1uPF_KcuYAnF_tCV-0D4skfb_NtgMsH7UqLXOfFlyccCBLVdID92v5DwktwMymrIBQCuPrMfXbSmIU4pdOPuRMhzy8WChOwk%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.

I won’t ever forget it, friend. Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide. I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight. And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick. Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them. I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate. This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House. Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c410968586a74b86af0c70fba4c283d7&_e=xOdAUHTRkLGaESogN3NMKmcbq_kpXX2eC6Eq30abncU-p-GcA7_hbsIbSWXmlzIaGvrUC66rweh4CfZdSNLGEjRTsuLrlJD1cnrm6WT_8iEATy0JPQnOEdmIrD0Macgt_zKoPIzxgZ7C_4jLEKvrXiBXjyEP2yJsblqeIX4x7rOSr7KzUO3ZZJVdK60VrOcUUNgvOyXd2H7nrRCpTFa7iGRRmlCtNenRVz-EdHhgFxXT6bY72PcJVpfBG7tGcdjr4I78lHBDN7IaOVv1P6aaHtrAYyb3ExCZOerLuDOzkbXKl779SlWnU0GjlYRgZVZFUVoVQSS05q0xBa7iLk2_KKfbWqUcugAWWZC-ES-gmzURopFlF9MhiouyXC5pHZ6c)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c410968586a74b86af0c70fba4c283d7&_e=xOdAUHTRkLGaESogN3NMKmcbq_kpXX2eC6Eq30abncU-p-GcA7_hbsIbSWXmlzIaGvrUC66rweh4CfZdSNLGEjRTsuLrlJD1cnrm6WT_8iEATy0JPQnOEdmIrD0Macgt_zKoPIzxgZ7C_4jLEKvrXiBXjyEP2yJsblqeIX4x7rOSr7KzUO3ZZJVdK60VrOcUUNgvOyXd2H7nrRCpTFa7iOpAJLbaS99Y7n4fsLX8GDngzYtaNFNJQx3tltOvCQSwzmJllelJ4XvPyzhSuVBgHvJiBx8pmK0OL06rYiYo8EkVTSZvFeZ9o5WNbZktKF5egzxWydWyz7H1GdO3_wuyiuyYOaMn_xF2B6QD34GqlBoy0uyP6EIHIOc35fs7tIji) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c410968586a74b86af0c70fba4c283d7&_e=xOdAUHTRkLGaESogN3NMKmcbq_kpXX2eC6Eq30abncU-p-GcA7_hbsIbSWXmlzIaGvrUC66rweh4CfZdSNLGEjRTsuLrlJD1cnrm6WT_8iEATy0JPQnOEdmIrD0Macgt_zKoPIzxgZ7C_4jLEKvrXiBXjyEP2yJsblqeIX4x7rOSr7KzUO3ZZJVdK60VrOcUUNgvOyXd2H7nrRCpTFa7iMa_T4jHs9C3kkczw1-60Ad4nngO7JvAZaCmmKCcZmc85auU2k_a7f5jAv1GVqYgdOF-TkEDVBynUuwNoUpNLdtS9TSgU4ugo36I1hgg6KJvlvzv2eFjRyOguSkLvR212akSr9jrwglouGtdSwoCyMtcUxeB2aQ9LKpdJou0rZxU)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan

body:
Friend, before I ask you to chip in to help us win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue, I want to take a moment to explain what our fight is all about.
I've said it before, and I'll say it again: When you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or work for tips, are raising children or caring for an elderly parent, I will always fight for you.
Whether it's capping the cost of insulin, demanding better wages, or working to enshrine reproductive freedoms into law, I'm fighting for the issues that matter most to Ohioans. Because that is what I was elected to do.
My self-funding opponent, Bernie Moreno, on the other hand, has proven time and time again that he does not care what the people of Ohio want. Instead, he's focused on cozying up to Donald Trump and advancing the MAGA agenda – from passing a national abortion ban to cutting taxes for his megadonor friends.
The people of Ohio, and our country, deserve better than that. But the odds are stacked against me: Polls show me and Moreno neck and neck – in the race that experts say will decide Senate control. That's why we set a goal to raise $250,000 before our May mid-month deadline, and I'm counting on you to help me reach it.
So please, friend, I'm personally asking: Will you chip in $5 or $25 today to split between my campaign and Serve America to help us defeat Trump's handpicked candidate Bernie Moreno, win in Ohio, and keep the Senate blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-sherrod]
Thank you for your support.
Sherrod

name: Eric Hansen, candidate for U.S. Senate
subject: Allow me to introduce myself...
body:
The change this country needs begins here in Delaware. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/voteerichansen.com/im-running-for-us-senate-14179307?e=dbd1068b05)
---
**If I may, please let me introduce myself. I’m Eric Hansen, Republican candidate for the U.S. Senate in 2024. If you’re like most people, you think the country is going the wrong direction. I strongly believe that the change that we need begins right here in Delaware.**
Why Delaware? Because winning a U.S. Senate seat in Delaware changes everything. It signals to the Democrats that moving too far to the left has consequences. It signals to the Republican Party that we can win any state. Finally, it positions Delaware to be one of the most consequential states in the next Congress.
Hopefully by now you’ve heard about my campaign to restore common-sense leadership in Washington, DC. **If not, well, I’m writing to you today to change that.**
In case you’re opening one of my emails - or hearing my name for the first time - here’s just a little bit about me:
* I’m a proud political outsider. I’ve spent my career until now in the private sector, working on ways to save money for American consumers.
* I’m a common-sense conservative who will work with ANYONE willing to put aside partisan politics for the good of our state - and our country.
* I’m a proud dad and husband.
* I’m a big believer that education is the key to unlocking success and opportunities.
* I firmly believe our nation is at a crossroads. We’re facing serious problems that career politicians have failed to address. We need more political outsiders in Washington who will focus on problem-solving and not partisan bickering.\

That’s me, in a nutshell! I would love nothing more than to have the chance to earn your trust and support between now and Election Day. In fact, it would be the greatest honor of my life to help make your life better. **But first, I want to make sure you’re really ok with getting email updates from me.**
I promise my team and I won’t spam you. We just send 1-2 emails each week with important facts about the state of Delaware and the nation, updates on the campaign, insights into my policy positions, and yes, the occasional fundraising request - no obligation. I think you’ll find the emails informative and worth your time. If that sounds good to you, [will you click on the button below and let me know](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=1745271278&e=dbd1068b05)?
Thank you - Eric Hansen

| I didn’t run for office to make history.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2634%2E35263%2EvyAamO)
Hi Peter — In a moment, **[I’ll ask you to make a donation to help me win my most competitive reelection yet.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-may24.HLGTSS&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240517_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2634%2E35263%2EvyAamO)** But first, I want to tell you more about how I got here. When I came out in college, I knew that I wanted to pursue a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-may24.HLGTSS&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240517_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2634%2E35263%2EvyAamO) Seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love helped me realize that I could do both. I could both run for office and be honest about who I am. From that moment on, I embarked on a career in public service and, thanks to the support of this grassroots team, eventually became the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. **But I didn’t run for office to make history — I ran to make a difference.** Each day working in the Senate offers an opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , that’s exactly what I’ve worked hard to do since I was elected. We’re at a pivotal moment, Peter, because right-wing Republicans are threatening to advance a hateful agenda that will take us back decades. | | | **Join Us in Supporting National Wildfire Awareness Month**
---

Dear Peter,
As we observe National Wildfire Awareness Month, we are reminded of the devastating impact wildfires have on our communities, landscapes, and lives. In Washington's 8th district, where the threat of wildfires is an ever-present concern, it's crucial that we come together to enhance our preparedness and response strategies.
As I've traveled across our district, I've witnessed firsthand the devastating impact of forest mismanagement and the severe damage caused by wildfires. With wildfire season now year-round, it's imperative to have a congresswoman who will prioritize accountability in the Forest Service and take action to mitigate the severity of wildfires.
---

This month, we are rallying support to bolster our district's wildfire readiness. A donation of $25, $50, or even $100 can make a significant difference.
Your contribution will enable our campaign to push for stronger policies on forest management, fire prevention, and emergency response funding.

__ | | | Hey there, Folks. We wanted to make sure you saw Amber’s message from yesterday. It was a very impassioned message about the stakes of this election and the future we would face should Lauren Boebert win. [**We hope you’ll read it and make a donation to John’s campaign to make sure he is able to defeat her.**](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=e97c7f9ee36b49f6997a7a28206a661e&_e=damfwoxoqXJso1-9U-p2UR4ICXsd-ollY8j0J7byd-lX2mYhoq3Ea9qi40H_ZyBruWs0sLwgqlwyUEpbVoVkZxbIFoWZpXWBRFzNldblRq-yVZ9NMdmy3Pg61FaPF042iCIDpPkJ_ctfyuTuMA1vYjU0c7ty9gJeUUnYKcbTelmNwRkFEscwLjELVCM208ODuVkzYNsOV3EkCweAdD1IYCyq2NFWA0ymccuna_fcTXpyWLUmyz1Xj0LfMcyHQZFH7XpvkF6cwkz8WKuBqRE0LTuVzz_7notW9kX2j3jM4Wn999-HwqbgvXOzGWNhMtiP0L5HnZW5A43qvS0l0NHPcitZ1Y5w36CrTfjrzQv1pYM3Hkl4fOmwkz1Z3lZNs436fnidz57Tb5OJh5n5aK4G4g%3D%3D) All the best,
Padora HQ \-------- Begin original message -------- [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=e97c7f9ee36b49f6997a7a28206a661e&_e=damfwoxoqXJso1-9U-p2UR4ICXsd-ollY8j0J7byd-lX2mYhoq3Ea9qi40H_ZyBruWs0sLwgqlwyUEpbVoVkZxbIFoWZpXWBRFzNldblRq-yVZ9NMdmy3Pg61FaPF042iCIDpPkJ_ctfyuTuMA1vYjU0c7ty9gJeUUnYKcbTelmNwRkFEscwLjELVCM208ODuVkzYNsOV3EkCweAdD1IYCyq2NFWA0ymccuna_fcTXpyWLUmyz1Xj0LfMcyHQZFHLRoaI-0B2KMoNWWm9yzZ5z0RF5wt_caBeiPbXa_A6fz0aNGh9y4namnXWoPUK_NOEaKGn_SOJqhEkRqx4xQVH3OkzTHrwTbTkZBrQ2etLRpTG5X9IHAASdabxkmS_d3WM_iaZKDjox0mVMmJkng28Q%3D%3D) Hi friends, it’s Amber Padora, John’s wife. I really don’t love speaking negatively about other women, but when a woman like Lauren Boebert wants to carpetbag into our district, strip my daughter of her right to make her own choices about her body, and support policies that make it more likely for my children to be shot while at school... well I just can’t be silent. Because this is who Lauren Boebert is. She supports policies that would lead to a nightmarish future for my children. **She does not believe in climate change. She wants to see a national abortion ban. She supports more guns without restrictions. [Peter, I’m about to ask you to chip in $15 to the Democratic Party of Wisconsin and Defeat Republicans. Grassroots supporters chipping in $15, or whatever they can, give our organization the consistent resources we need to get ahead of fire drills and far-right extremism.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85152823/473826924/-1333215174?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240517_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5NzQ3OThhLTg0MTQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ypr9SaObWXoFF8GtIR3qIFsbs9T0vXVlECQz_2n6iyI=)

**But let me explain the stakes with a hypothetical:** On Election Night, the Republican presidential candidate has an early lead in Wisconsin but thousands of absentee ballots have yet to be counted. The rest of the nation watches, waiting for Wisconsin to determine the outcome of another presidential race.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85152826/473826927/-1333215174?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240517_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5NzQ3OThhLTg0MTQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ypr9SaObWXoFF8GtIR3qIFsbs9T0vXVlECQz_2n6iyI=)
Then, for whatever reason, the nation is waiting on the electoral votes in Wisconsin to call the entire presidential election. There could be a scenario where GOP officials and far-right pundits alike push to call the election for the Republican candidate, Donald Trump.

**Peter, our entire team would be on high alert.**

Our organizing and analytics teams would be hard at work crunching the numbers and determining whose votes could be jeopardized.

Our political and voter protection teams would build the case to reject hasty rulings and make sure every single vote is counted before hastily calling an election.

Our communications team would spread the message far and wide, brief me on how to best message this moment, and help Democrats best advocate to count all votes.

body:
Fellow Conservative,

Donald Trump Jr. says it all in the video. Our race is the top Senate race in the country; flipping this seat is critical to the success of President Trump’s America First Agenda.

But I’ve fallen behind in the fundraising race by more than 3 to 1. We’re asking a lot of you, but we’ll never catch up with Jon Tester at our current pace.

That’s not something I can tolerate. \*\*If we fail, he will buy another six-year term in the U.S. Senate like he always does\*\* , and our shot at the majority will be lost for the next decade.

\*\*

Watch a special message from Don Jr. and Tim Sheehy → ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=7227679.3142.1.084349704c1b406dc5bf563459a106c3 ) \*\*

But if you and every freedom-loving American reading this right now act on this request for help, we’ve got a real shot to take down the Beltway’s favorite insider.

But please, don’t take my word for it. You know Don Jr., one of our campaign’s most dedicated supporters and one of the most patriotic Americans I know. He’s vouching for my candidacy, and I hope his support encourages you to join us.

->

\*\*WATCH AND SUPPORT→\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=7227679.3143.1.8dce95378b8a0fcddf547b4d7dddcf5e ) <-

Montana deserves better than a senator who campaigns on being a moderate but votes with Democrat Joe Biden 91% of the time.

We deserve better than a liberal career politician who took more cash from DC lobbyists than any other remember of Congress.

\*\*Jon Tester is bought and paid for by the Democrat establishment.\*\*

First and foremost, Jon Tester is a fraud, and Montana deserves better. But I’m running _ \*\*FOR AMERICA\*\* _, and the winner of this race will cast the deciding vote for the Senate majority.

-> \*\*HELP TIM SHEEHY FLIP THE SENATE→\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=7227679.3144.1.948268734d50b3c575b4132d642ea726 )<-

I’m proud to have the endorsement of Don Jr., and I hope you’ll honor me with your support today, too.

Don’t miss Don Jr’s. message here →\*\*link ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=7227679.3145.1.52437aa6521367e527bb41cefdbc7aa0 )\*\*

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy

Republican for U.S. Senate, Montana

WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. Convention planning and a Big Event this week!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_invite&n=1)

Friday, May 17, 2024 |
### **We've got a lot to talk about this month**
Peter -- Join us Monday May 20th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call We're talking about Convention, Candidates, Signatures and a newly added event coming up next week!
* * *
### **New Event Added! May 22nd in Harrisburg**
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uwl9pDp8g-rX1WnI3QBeNAx-fH6JOJZ8WLkW9b1cqKdznYHsxOz-dEB1dtrpi0DjOA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_invite&n=2) We are so happy to have Forward Party Co-Chair Lt. Governor Kerry Healey and CEO Lindsey Williams Drath in our state to make an exciting announcement. We will be celebrating an endorsement and affiliation with an incumbent candidate for statewide office in Pennsylvania. This is a great chance to get good press but it's also a sign that there are many people who agree with our message. This will be one of the biggest announcements we've ever made and it's coming together quickly. If you can join us in the beautiful Capital Rotunda on May 22nd at 2pm, you won't regret it. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uwl9pDp8g-rX1WnI3QBeNAx-fH6JOJZ8WLkW9b1cqKdznYHsxOz-dEB1dtrpi0DjOA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_invite&n=3 "May 22nd Announcement") [May 22nd Announcement](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uwl9pDp8g-rX1WnI3QBeNAx-fH6JOJZ8WLkW9b1cqKdznYHsxOz-dEB1dtrpi0DjOA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_invite&n=3)
---
It's also a great time to reach out to your personal representative and see if you can visit their office while you're in town.
* * *
### **We hope you can join us at our convention on June 1st**
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u2f82VcN49yJ3Wou-X6QZ0iX7Wo282dwEVAVW2OXhRwp9nFWgJUYIxm1C0IOL0s56czjj0_b1t4xvpmls2l_Pm8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_invite&n=4)
One of the best days since the forming of the PA Forward Party was May 20, 2023 when we had our first PA Forward Summit. We took huge organizational steps and met many people in person for the first time.
Many things have changed since then. We've had affiliation events and even got our first Forwardist in office. We've had new supporters, volunteers, and leaders join our ranks.
Now, as we work towards what is by far, our most ambitious election season since we started, please join us to look to the future. We've sometimes been referred to as a group for the politically homeless. That won't feel true when you're with so many people working to build a place we can all call home.
**Where:**
Gettysburg Hilton Garden Inn
1061 York Road
Gettysburg, PA 17325
**When:**
June 1st, 2024 - 10am - 6pm
Lunch and drink are included with the $30 ticket price.

A new report by the Institute for Energy Research (IER), a nonprofit
dedicated to the study of the impact of government regulation on
